title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 50 wpm minimum (65+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

title: Closara: Cold Outreach & Demand Specialist
description:
Cold Outreach & Demand Specialist: Signal Research  ·  Cold
  ·  Direct-Response Copy  ·  Booking the Right Rooms



You can look at a company for ninety seconds and know the one line that’ll get a reply. Here, that’s the whole job.



Read this first — it’s the first test:

We could’ve written the usual ad. “Fast-growing company seeks motivated
 marketing specialist to join our dynamic team.” You’ve read that one four hundred times. So have the decision-makers we
 — which is exactly why we don’t send it, and why this ad reads like a person wrote it, not an HR template.



Here’s the honest version. This is one seat with one job: fill the calendar with the right conversations. Find the right person at the right company, work out the one true thing worth saying to them, say it like a human, and book the call. You don’t build funnels. You don’t run ads. You don’t wire automations. Someone else owns each of those. You own the cold open — and, in time, every word of outbound copy we send.



If you’re a generalist who “also does a bit of
,” this isn’t your seat, and the application below filters you out in about a minute. If you’re the person who gets a genuine kick out of pulling a 20% reply rate on a tight list of 200 while the industry average sits near 3 — keep reading.



APPLICATION KEY   Start your application with the word “COLD OPEN” and one sentence naming the best reply rate you’ve ever pulled on a cold campaign, and roughly how big the list was. No keyword, no read.



01   What Closara is (the sixty-second version)

Closara is the lead-to-revenue layer for sales-led businesses. In plain terms: we make sure no lead a business paid for ever slips through the cracks, and we place qualified demand with operators set up to take more of it. We’re Australian, we’re early, and we’re deliberately building this as a set of specialists who are each the best at one thing — not generalists who are average at five. You’d be the outbound one.



The founder (Sash) — and, as we grow, our closing team — runs every sales call and closes every deal. Your job stops at a booked, confirmed call in the calendar. You find them, you warm them, you book them. We take it from there.

We start with Australian homeowner verticals — solar and battery first, then the rest of the homeowner market. From there the map gets bigger: financial-services verticals as our legal clearances land, and other countries after that. The person who owns outbound while that map expands is the person who wrote the first cold
. That’s the seat you’re applying for.



02   What you’d actually own:

-The list. Not a bought blast — a tight, researched list where every single name has a reason to hear from us. High-ticket lead buyers in approved verticals (solar and battery first). You find the exact decision-maker and the signal that makes now the right moment: they’re running ads, they’ve posted a sales role, they’ve got a quiz funnel live, they just expanded. Signal-based, never spray-and-pray — because reaching the right person at the right moment is the difference between a 3% reply rate and a 20% one.

-The first line. The whole game. “Hi {first_name}” is not personalisation and hasn’t been for years. You open with one specific, true observation about their business that proves you actually looked. We have a house method for this — you’ll learn it and run it at volume without it ever reading like a template.

-The copy behind it all. You own the cold open (bespoke, per prospect) and the follow-up ladder (templated, written once per vertical, that the non-repliers drop into). As you prove the beachhead, you become the voice behind Closara’s own outbound and nurture copy too — same craft, same house voice. You write the sequences; our tech operator wires and runs them. The words are yours; the machine isn’t.

-The sequence. Multi-step, multi-channel —
 carrying the ask, LinkedIn carrying the recognition, the odd SMS. Two touches a week, no touch repeating an angle, every one short enough to read on a phone at a red light. Run off dedicated, warmed sending domains — never our primary.

-Deliverability. The un-sexy part that makes or breaks everything, and it’s non-negotiable knowledge. SPF, DKIM, DMARC aligned and passing. Spam complaints under 0.1% and never near 0.3%. One-click unsubscribe done properly. Warm-up, volume ramps, list hygiene. In 2026 a badly-run domain doesn’t land in spam — it gets rejected outright and never arrives. You protect our sending reputation like it’s your own money. It’s ours.

-The replies. You handle the back-and-forth by
 and DM with exactly one objective: a booked call in the calendar. Calm, quick, human. You never quote a price. You never negotiate. (More on that below — it matters more than anything else in this ad.)

-AI, used properly. You lean on AI hard — Claude, ChatGPT — for research, drafting and variants. But you have the ear to catch when AI sounds like AI, and the skill to prompt it so the output reads like a busy human typed it in under a minute. The market is drowning in obviously-robotic cold
 right now. That’s our opening: the interrupt is sounding real.

-A daily glance at the inbox (small, capped). Once a day, a quick look at DMs on the company socials and LinkedIn — flag anything that’s actually a buyer and pass it into the flow. That’s it. A ~10% side-duty, not a second job. The seat is outbound.



03   The part that makes this role special — you ARE the pattern interrupt:

Most cold outreach people never get this: in a market drowning in hype, the interrupt is understatement. In a market drowning in beige, the interrupt is warmth. You read the target’s inbox first, then you send the opposite of what’s already in it.

To show you exactly what we mean — and what bar you’re being hired to hit — here’s the same moment done two ways.

-What the whole market sends:

“Hi there! I hope this
 finds you well. My name is [X] and I’m reaching out from [Company], a leading provider of high-quality lead generation solutions. We help businesses like yours scale their revenue with our proven system. Would you be open to a quick 15-minute call this week to explore synergies?”



-What we send:

Subject: your quote form

Hey Dave — quick one. Your battery ad drops people on the homepage instead of a matching page, and your quote form asks nine questions. Homeowners bail around four. Free tip, do what you like with it.

While I’ve got you: I place exclusive solar leads, one business per lead, and I’m working out where the next lot should go. Reckon you might suit. Half an hour this week — Tue 10 or Thu 2?

Sash



One of those gets deleted. The other gets a reply. If you can feel why — the specificity, the value before the ask, the total absence of “synergies” — you might be who we’re looking for. If you’d have written the first one, you wouldn’t be happy here anyway.



Your job is to produce the second kind — every time, at volume, in the house voice, without it ever going stale. That’s a real skill. We pay for it and we take it seriously.



04   What you need

Must have:

-A real cold-outreach track record you can show. Not “I’ve done
 marketing.” A specific campaign YOU ran — the tool, the domain setup, the sequence, and the actual reply / positive-reply rates. Screenshots fine, redact whatever you need to. -First thing we look at.

-Deliverability fluency. If warm-up, DMARC and spam-complaint rate aren’t second nature, this isn’t your seat. We’ll ask, and we’ll know. A brilliant writer who’s torched a sending domain is worse than useless to us.

-Genuinely good direct-response copywriting. Short, specific, human. Send 2–3 cold
s you actually wrote. We’re reading for ear, not grammar.

-AI-native. You use AI daily to work faster, and you can make it sound like a person. You keep up — you know what changed this quarter.

-Enough automation sense to brief a builder. You don’t wire the automations yourself — we have a tech operator for that. But you understand the workflow well enough to spec it and hand it over cleanly. “I know what I want automated and I can explain it” is the bar, not “I can build it.”

-Excellent written English and a calm, human touch in replies.

-Full-time, single focus, AEST-overlapping hours. This is your one thing.

Bonus points"

-Deep with the modern stack — Apollo for data and sequencing, Instantly or Smartlead for cold send, and Clay for signal enrichment at scale. Say so loudly if you’ve run these in anger.

-LinkedIn outbound done manually and well — no banned automation; we don’t risk the founder’s account.

-You’ve booked calls for a founder-led sales motion before and know how to qualify without over-qualifying.

-You’ve worked a homeowner-services or high-ticket local-business vertical. 



05   The two hard rules — read these twice:

Break either of these and it doesn’t matter how good your reply rate is.

-Rule one: you never talk price. Not a number, not a range, not “it depends but usually around.” Our entire model runs on price being worked out live on the call, off the prospect’s own numbers. Your job is to get them into that room. The moment you quote anything, you’ve undercut the whole business. When they ask — and they will — you have one move: “That’s the call. I’ll get you in with Sash.” We test this in the application. A miss here is disqualifying.

-Rule two: approved verticals only. You work the GO list (solar and battery first; then roofing, HVAC, hot water, security, home improvement). Regulated verticals — mortgage, insurance, finance, property investment, wealth — are untouchable without written sign-off. Legal MVA / personal-injury / workers-comp lead work is never on, full stop. Not sure whether a vertical is approved? You ask before you send. Never guess.



06   The test — do this with your application

This is the real filter, and it’s deliberately harder than most job tests. A capable operator will enjoy it. Do all four parts:

1. Pick a real target and name the signal. Find a real Australian solar & battery installer in the Meta Ad Library. Tell us the one buying signal you’d lead with — and why that signal, over everything else you could have chosen.

2. Write the cold open. The first-touch
, under 80 words, subject line included, built around that signal. This is the only
 that’s bespoke, so it has to earn the reply on its own.

3. Write the follow-up ladder. Three short templated touches the non-repliers drop into after the cold open — the ones you’d reuse across every prospect in the vertical. Show us you understand the model: one custom open, a templated ladder behind it.

4. Show us the machine. In a few sentences: how would you build and enrich a list of 200 of these, at a reply rate you’d stake your name on — what tools, what signals, what you’d automate and what you’d keep by hand? And name the spam-complaint rate you’d never cross, and how you’d warm a fresh domain before any of this goes out.

Get part 4 wrong on the deliverability numbers and the rest doesn’t matter — that’s the tell between someone who’s run real campaigns and someone who’s only read about them.



07   The money — and how it grows:

We pay a modest base and real money on closes. You are not paid for booking a call, or even for a call that shows up — you’re paid when a client you sourced actually signs on and pays. That’s the only number that means anything to either of us, and it’s how a genuinely good operator makes this a well-paid seat.

-Base: US$600–900/month depending on proven depth, full-time, paid reliably.

-Close commission: US$200 for every new client you sourced who commits to an ongoing schedule and pays their first real invoice — not a test pilot. A tyre-kicker who takes a trial and vanishes doesn’t count; a committed, paying client does.

-Continuity kicker: a further US$100 if that client is still active and paying at 90 days — because we want you booking the right buyers, not just any buyer.

-Monthly accelerator: land 5 or more committed clients in a single month and you get an extra US$200 on top. That’s a great month, and it should feel like one.

-Where it heads: string a few closes together in a month and this becomes a genuinely well-paid seat. The better your booked-and-closed numbers, the more you earn — and this is the person who grows into owning outbound across every vertical we open, and writing the copy behind all of it.



What you could earn

A month where you…

-find your feet =  US$950

-hit your stride = US$1,550

-have a strong month US$2,350

*Illustrative, on a US$750 base; the strong month includes the US$200 bonus for landing 5 in a month. A strong operator clears US$25,000+ a year — and that’s before we open the next vertical and the next country, which is exactly where this seat is heading. The 90-day kicker lands about three months after a close, so it stacks as your book of committed clients grows.



How to apply

Send: (1) the keyword “COLD OPEN” + your best cold reply rate and rough list size; (2) a walkthrough of one real campaign you ran — tool, domain setup, sequence, reply rate (screenshots fine, redacted fine); (3) 2–3 cold
s you wrote; (4) all four parts of the test above; (5) a 60–90 second Loom introducing yourself in English; (6) confirmation you can work AEST-overlapping hours, full-time.

If your application starts with the keyword, shows a real campaign, and nails the test — you’re already ahead of almost everyone. Those things ARE the job.

title: Architectural Content & Community Coordinator – Residential Layout Design
description:
We are looking for a proactive Architecture Graduate / Junior Architect to help grow and manage a new global online community focused on residential layouts, renovations, property uplift and floor-plan improvement.



This is not a traditional drafting-only role and not a generic social media VA role.



You will combine your architectural knowledge with content creation, social media, AI tools and community management.



The project includes two Skool communities:



- Residential Layout & Renovation Free

- Residential Layout & Renovation Pro



Our goal is to grow an international audience of renovators, property flippers, investors, small builders, homeowners and junior designers, then convert engaged free members into paid Pro members.



Main Responsibilities



Architectural Content



- Review residential floor plans and identify common layout problems

- Develop simple before-and-after layout concepts

- Create content around circulation, room flow, furniture planning, zoning and renovation uplift

- Create floor-plan case studies and educational examples

- Prepare short layout explanations and practical design tips

- Escalate complex architectural or technical design questions for senior review



Social Media & Content Creation



- Create Instagram and
 posts, carousels and short-form videos

- Create simple AI-assisted educational videos using floor plans, arrows, highlights and voiceovers

- Use tools such as Canva, CapCut, ChatGPT and similar AI tools

- Repurpose one architectural idea into multiple content formats

- Create engaging hooks such as:

        - “What’s wrong with this floor plan?”

        - “Can this 3-bed become a 4-bed?”

        - “Spot the wasted space”

        - Before vs After layout transformations



Skool Community Management



- Upload and organise content in both Free and Pro communities

- Welcome new members

- Reply to general questions and comments

- Encourage engagement and discussions

- Manage layout challenges and member submissions

- Promote Free ? Pro upgrades

- Maintain the resource and layout libraries



Growth & Outreach



- Engage with relevant Instagram and
 audiences

- Participate helpfully in renovation, property-flipping, investing and home-improvement communities

- Invite suitable users into the free community

- Track which content attracts members and converts them to Pro

- Provide a simple weekly performance report



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who:



- is an Architecture Graduate or Junior Architect

- has around 1–3 years of architecture/residential design experience

- has good residential layout and space-planning skills

- understands floor plans and renovation concepts

- has strong written English

- is proactive and can work independently

- enjoys content creation and social media

- is confident using Canva

- can create/edit short-form video content using CapCut or similar

- is comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT

- can manage tasks and deadlines without constant supervision

- is creative and interested in growing an online design community



Experience with Skool is helpful but not essential.



Revit expertise is not required. Good design thinking, communication and content skills are more important.



Working Style



You will be expected to manage most routine content and community work independently.



Senior architectural input will be available when:



- a layout is particularly complex

- structural implications may exist

- technical/code issues arise

- you are unsure about the best design solution



We want someone who can take initiative rather than waiting for instructions for every task.



Initial Trial



This will begin as a 2-month trial project.



If the project gains traction and the collaboration works well, there is potential for ongoing work and increased responsibility.



To Apply



Please include:



- A short introduction about your architecture experience

- Examples of residential plans or layout work you have completed

- Examples of social media graphics, videos or content you have created, if available

- Which tools you use for architecture, graphics, video editing and AI

- Why you think you would be a good fit for a role combining architecture + content + community growth



Please also begin your application with the words:



BETTER LAYOUTS



This helps us confirm that you read the full job post.

About the Role



My client owns two growing businesses: an AI consulting company and a real estate investment business. I am looking for an experienced Operations & Executive Virtual Assistant who thrives on organization, accountability, and continuous improvement.



This is not a traditional administrative assistant role. I am looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership, improving processes, anticipating needs, and ensuring that day-to-day operations run efficiently with minimal supervision.



You will become my trusted operational partner, allowing me to focus on growing the business while you keep projects, priorities, communications, and operations moving forward.



During your first 30 days, you will help refine and optimize our property management operations. Once those systems are operating efficiently, your primary focus will shift toward supporting the operational growth of my AI consulting business.

Executive Support:

- Manage multiple calendars, including two personal Google Calendars and one business calendar.

- Coordinate meetings, appointments, and scheduling priorities.

- Organize business priorities, projects, and action items.

- Track recurring deadlines, including subscriptions, licenses, certifications, renewals, and compliance requirements, using Rocket Money,
 notifications, and other business systems.

- Prepare lease renewals, reports, correspondence, and recurring business documents using established templates.

- Organize and maintain digital files, contracts, and business documentation.

- Keep projects organized and proactively communicate priorities, risks, and upcoming deadlines.

- Follow up on outstanding action items to ensure they are completed on time.



Business Operations:

- Serve as the primary point of coordination for daily business operations.

- Coordinate communications with AI consulting clients, students, tenants, vendors, contractors, and strategic partners.

- Support onboarding for new AI consulting clients and students, ensuring they receive timely communication, required resources, and a positive client experience.

- Ensure AI consulting client records remain accurate, complete, and up to date by coordinating with the Technical Support & Customer Success Specialist as needed.

- Monitor business goals, KPIs, operational priorities, and recurring business activities.

- Maintain and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

- Research and apply for speaking engagements, podcasts, networking events, partnerships, and other business development opportunities.

- Assist with coordinating marketing initiatives, cohort communications, and client follow-up to help ensure projects remain on schedule.

- Track outstanding action items and proactively follow through until completion.

- Identify opportunities to improve business processes and operational efficiency(ongoing).



Property Management Operations:

Initially, you will focus on optimizing and organizing our property management operations using Buildium. Once these systems are refined, property management responsibilities will represent approximately 10 percent of your weekly workload.



Responsibilities include:

- Communicate professionally with tenants, contractors, and vendors.

Please send your resume, portfolio, and a CURRENT video introduction (no exceptions) speaking on a time you assisted your CEO with their property management, acknowledge review of the job description and salary, and use at least 8 apply points.

Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back

title: AI Generalist
description:
Looking for an AI Generalist



We are looking for an AI Generalist, someone who can take a script and a likeness and hand back finished, ultra realistic video. Generation, voice, lip-sync, quality control, all of it.



THE ROLE:



We produce realistic AI reels built around one consistent on camera personality. You own the machine that makes them.



End to end: identity training, prompting, model selection, voice cloning, lipsync, and the quality bar before anything reaches an editor.



This is daily volume work. Not one off projects.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:



- Strong skills creating realistic AI content (video and image)

- Hands on across the current stack: Higgsfield, Soul ID or LoRA style identity training, HeyGen, Kling, Veo, Seedance, ElevenLabs

- You can hold ONE face consistent across dozens of clips with zero drift

- You know which model to reach for per shot instead of forcing everything through one tool

- You catch the tells: dead eyes, bad hands, lipsync slip, plastic skin, and you re-render instead of shipping it

- You work from a real person's likeness, not just stock avatars or fully synthetic characters

- You document what worked so clip 50 is faster than clip 5

- Professional and reliable. This is not a "just getting started" role



BIG BONUS POINTS IF:



- You can edit too: clean cuts, text pop ups, motion, fonts, the polished pro stuff

- You have built a repeatable system, not just one off winners

- You understand hooks, pacing, and retention on short form

- You have run AI content that performed and can show the numbers



If you have that on top of everything else, you are exactly who we want.



HOW TO APPLY:



Do not send random AI content. We want to see the real person and the AI clone that holds up as a REAL person on camera.



Send:



1. Your best realistic AI clone or avatar work, polished

2. 3 or more clips of the SAME face so we can see consistency across generations

3. Your tool stack and how you would approach a daily volume build

4. A quick note on your experience and your rates



ROOM TO GROW:



This starts project based and scales into an ongoing role as output ramps. The right person grows into owning the full production pipeline and briefing the editors under them.



NEWER, BUT GOT THE SKILLS?



No client work yet but you make realistic AI content and can prove consistency? Make a sample and send it in. Skill speaks louder than a resume.



Excited to find the right person. Send your best.

AI tools

* CRM setup, maintenance, and lead tracking.

* Working with Australian businesses.

* Confident asking questions when information is genuinely missing.

We're not trying to be the biggest roofing company — we're trying to be the most trusted. We're building a growing door-to-door appointment program, and this role is at the center of it.



You'll work directly with the owners. Your work will be visible, your ideas will be used, and as the program grows, this role grows with it — the first coordinator is positioned to lead the coordination team that follows.



THE ROLE — TWO HALVES



Half 1: Recruiting Coordinator



Review new Indeed applicants quickly (speed wins candidates — you'll own our 15-minute response standard)

Run 10–15 minute phone screening interviews with US job candidates and book the strong ones into in-person interviews with our Director

Keep hired candidates engaged and confirmed between hiring and their training start date

Build new hiring channels: US college outreach, referral program administration, and smart ideas from your own research



Half 2: Appointment Coordinator



Run our three-call confirmation system with US homeowners: qualify new appointments, confirm details and decision-makers, and make final time checks

Follow our full call scripts (complete training provided — you'll know exactly what to say)

Log every call outcome accurately in our scheduling system — our pay and metrics run on your logs

You are the reason our appointment cancellation rate stays low, and you're bonused for it



PAY STRUCTURE (in USD)



Base: $1,400/month, paid twice monthly ($700 on the 15th, $700 + all bonuses at month end)

Sit-Rate Bonus: $150/month when the team's appointment sit rate is 90%+ ($100 at 85–89.9%)

Hiring Bonus: $50 for every new hire who completes our two-week training program

13th Month Pay: one extra month of base pay in December, pro-rated for partial years

Paid Time Off: 6 paid US holidays + 10 paid vacation days per year (taken during our slower seasons)

A strong month looks like: $1,400 base + $150 sit-rate bonus + $400 in hiring bonuses = $1,950. A strong full year with 13th month: $20,000+ USD

Compensation reviewed at the one-year mark for strong performers



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Excellent spoken English — warm, clear, confident, and natural on the phone. This is the #1 requirement. You'll be talking with American homeowners and job candidates all day.

At least 1–2 years of experience in a call center, BPO, appointment setting, recruiting, virtual assistance, or customer service role (voice experience strongly preferred)

Organized and self-managing — you'll run your own pipeline with real trust and real accountability

Detail-obsessed with logging and follow-up — our whole pay system depends on accurate records

Reliable setup: fast internet, backup power/internet plan, quiet workspace, quality headset

Able to genuinely commit to the US Eastern schedule long-term — please be honest with yourself about the night shift before applying

Coachable, honest, and looking for a home, not a gig



WHAT YOU GET FROM US



Complete training: a full written training packet, call scripts, recorded call examples, and a paid 30-day supervised ramp — you will never be thrown in unprepared

Direct access to the owners with a weekly video meeting

Stable, on-time pay in USD, every month, twice a month

A long-term seat in a growing program with a real leadership path



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — this is the first test)



Use the subject line: "Trusted Coordinator — [Your Name]"

In your application, tell us: your relevant experience, your internet speed and backup plan, and confirm you can work the US Eastern schedule

Include a 1–2 minute voice recording (Vocaroo or similar link) answering: "Tell us about a time you had to win someone's trust over the phone."



Applications without the subject line and voice recording will not be reviewed. We respond to qualified applicants quickly.

title: Sauna Sales & Support Specialist - $1,100 base + commission (realistic $2,000–$3,500/mo) - US EST Hours
description:
Read this whole post before applying. There's a specific instruction at the bottom and I only read applications that follow it.



We sell sauna heaters and sauna kits across the United States. Our customers are homeowners building a new sauna or looking to replace/upgrade their sauna heater, construction companies specifying equipment for a client, and professional sauna builders ordering for multiple projects. Orders range from a single heater to complete saunas well over $10,000.



They come to us because they need to figure out what to buy. What size heater for the room. Whether the specs work for the build. Which brands/models hold up. Your job is to be the person who works that out with them and gets the order.



This is a sales role with a real support component, not a ticket-closing job. 



COMPENSATION



Base: $1,100 USD/month

Commission: 1% of every order you close. We sell complete sauna packages upwards of $10,000, so the bigger orders pay real money

Realistic total: $2,000–$3,500/month once you're ramped



THE HOURS



9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



This is a varied role. Some of it is live conversation, but a lot of it is quiet work: figuring out the right answer, building the quote, and chasing it down.



Sales:

- Take inbound sales calls and texts from homeowners, contractors and sauna builders

- Make outbound calls and texts to warm prospects who've enquired, requested a quote, or abandoned a cart

- Research the right solution for a customer's build and put together product recommendations based on their room, their timeline and their budget

- Create quotes in Shopify and send them out

- Follow up on open quotes. This is where most of the commission lives, and it's the part most people neglect

- Take orders over the phone



Support:

- Handle inbound chat and

- Answer technical questions about heater and sauna specifications

- Work through problems with customers, including liaising with vendors' technical teams to get a real answer rather than a guess

- Process returns and refunds

- Follow up with customers after their equipment arrives, to make sure the install went well and to catch problems early

- Realistically, you will not be on the phone all day. Expect a mix: sales and support calls, then long stretches of research, quoting, follow-up and
.



WHO THIS IS FOR



Required:

- Near-native spoken and written English. Clear and easy for an American to understand on a bad phone connection, and clean enough to write a quote
 to a contractor

- Real sales experience. If you've sold anything expensive over the phone or by
 - HVAC, hot tubs, pools, generators, solar, appliances, windows, building materials, insurance, real estate and of course saunas, I want to talk to you

- Comfortable with a customer who says "let me think about it," and willing to follow up until you get an answer

- Organised enough to keep 30 open quotes moving without dropping any

- 50+ WPM typing

- Reliable internet (10 Mbps+) and a quiet place to take calls

- You can commit to these hours for at least a year



Nice to have, genuinely not required:

- Shopify experience

- Anything to do with saunas, spas, pools, hot tubs, construction or home improvement

- Basic electrical literacy (volts, amps, breakers)

- You do not need to know anything about saunas. We'll teach you that, and we have the materials to do it properly. What we can't teach is how you sound on the phone and whether you chase a quote.



ABOUT US



We're a team of 20 running several ecommerce sites. It's a close, highly motivated group and everyone here cares about doing the work properly. You won't get lost in a corporate structure, and you won't be firefighting at midnight either. Steady work, taken seriously, by people who like working together.



On a team this size your work is visible from day one. If this goes well, you'd be training the next hires and eventually leading the team.



HOW TO APPLY



Three things. Applications missing any of them get skipped, no exceptions.



1. Start your message with the word SAUNA-READY so I know you read this far.

2. Record a video clip (not audio) covering two parts:



Part 1 - introduce yourself. How much sales experience you have, whether you've used Shopify, what industries you've worked in, and why we should hire you. Keep it tight.



Part 2 - answer this as if you were on the phone with a real customer:



"Hi, I'm building a sauna in my backyard. It's about 7 feet by 8 feet with a 7-foot ceiling, and one wall is going to be glass. I have no idea what size heater I need. Can you help?"



You are not expected to know the right answer. I'm listening to how you sound and what questions you ask. Upload the video anywhere and paste the link.



3. In two or three sentences, tell me about one time you sold something expensive to someone who wasn't sure. What did they say, and what did you say back?



I read every application that follows those three steps. If you're a fit, you'll hear from me within 3 business days.

We're a small, close team, fully remote, and we care a great deal about the women who come to us.



Women find us, reach out, and genuinely want help — and then some of them quietly slip away because nobody followed up well enough. I'm looking for someone to own our front door: the leads, the phone, the follow-up, and the conversation that turns an interested woman into a patient.



This is a sales role, and it's also the first voice a woman hears from our practice. Both have to be true at once.



About the pay, before anything else. Your base is $7/hour, but this role is built so your income follows your results, not the clock. You earn a bonus on every patient and member you bring in, so $1,000+ a month is well within reach if you convert well. Do this properly and you should out-earn the hourly rate comfortably.



What you'll do

- Follow up quickly with every woman who reaches out, and guide her toward booking

- Have the real conversation: what we offer, what it costs, and what's holding her back

- Turn interested women into patients and members

- Keep following up with the ones who say "let me think about it" — this is where most of the value lives

- Answer and return calls on our practice phone during US hours

- Schedule patient follow-ups and make sure nothing sits unanswered



Who I'm looking for



Near-native English comes first, and it isn't negotiable. You'll be on the phone with American women talking about deeply personal things. You need to sound warm, natural, and completely at ease — able to hear hesitation in someone's voice and respond to it. Not scripted. Not stiff.



- You've actually sold something and closed it. Health, wellness, coaching, or memberships is a real plus

- You're comfortable with money. You can say a price out loud and then stay quiet

- You're warm, not pushy. Hard-closing will damage the trust our patients place in us

- You run yourself. You'll own the follow-up. Nobody will chase you

- You can work a consistent 4-hour block each weekday, on US Eastern time

- This role is open to women only. Our patients are women discussing fertility and hormones, and they've told us plainly that they're more comfortable speaking with another woman



The details

- Pay: $7/hour base, plus a bonus on every patient and member you bring in. A strong month lands around $1,000+ per month

- Hours: 20 per week to start — the same 4-hour block each weekday, US Eastern

- Growth: 4-week paid fellowship ? 3 months part-time ? full-time based on performance

- We provide: our practice phone system, Notion, and Toggl



How to apply

1. Application and voice recording: 
tion.site/3b70d95da57c80ec9e3ff25ac24cd60a.

2. Interview. A real conversation, with some role-play.

3. Fellowship. A paid 4 weeks working alongside us. That's how we both find out if this is right.



If you're wonderful on the phone and you want your work to genuinely change how a woman feels in her own body, I'd love to hear from you.



— Abrar

Proficient in
 flows end to end: you've written the copy, designed the
s, and built them live in Klaviyo yourself, all on the same flow, more than once. That hands-on fluency is what lets you load, QA, and ship across 60+ brands without anything getting lost between the design file and the live send. 





WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Load approved designs into Klaviyo or 
 and set them
 triggers, filters, conditional splits, dynamic sections

 so images render sharp, never one compressed block

- Configure sender address, sending domain, footer snippets, alt text, UTMs, discount codes, and destination links

- Audit live flows and produce a document with screenshots: what's broken, what's missing, how to improve it



2. REVENUE REPORTING (the most frequent request in this role)

- Build last-30-day reports in batches of 4 to 18 brands: total generated, flows vs campaigns, then the performance percentage against that brand's specific rate with the retainer alongside

Required

s, and built them live in Klaviyo on the same flow, more than once. We'll ask you to walk us through one

title: TikTok Shop Manager — Supplement Brand (EXPERIENCED ONLY!)
description:
TikTok Shop Manager — Supplement Brand



We are hiring an experienced **TikTok Shop Manager** to take full ownership of our TikTok Shop creator and affiliate program for a fast-growing supplement brand.



This is not an entry-level role. You must have direct experience managing TikTok Shop for a consumer brand and be able to provide proof of your results.



## Role Overview



You will be responsible for building, managing, and scaling our TikTok Shop program from A to Z, including creator sourcing, affiliate recruitment, outreach, product sampling, relationship management, content coordination, performance tracking, and revenue growth.



We are looking for someone proactive who can independently develop the strategy, execute it, analyze performance, and continuously improve the program without needing constant direction.



## Responsibilities



### Creator and Affiliate Recruitment



* Identify and recruit TikTok creators who are a strong fit for our products and target customers

* Conduct high-volume creator outreach through TikTok Shop,
, direct messages, agencies, and other sourcing platforms

* Build and maintain a structured pipeline of prospective, contacted, approved, active, and high-performing creators

* Negotiate affiliate commissions, flat fees, performance incentives, and content agreements when required

* Develop relationships with creators, affiliate managers, creator agencies, and TikTok Shop partners



### Product Sampling



* Manage the complete product sampling process from creator approval to delivery

* Evaluate sample requests based on creator quality, audience relevance, engagement, content history, and sales potential

* Coordinate product shipments with our fulfillment and operations teams

* Follow up with creators after delivery to ensure content is produced

* Track sample costs, content completion rates, creator activation rates, and revenue generated per sample

* Prevent excessive or low-quality sampling that does not generate content or sales



### Creator Management



* Create onboarding instructions, product education, selling points, content guidelines, and compliance requirements

* Maintain consistent communication with creators before and after they receive products

* Encourage creators to produce additional videos, test new hooks, and participate in promotions

* Identify top-performing affiliates and develop deeper partnerships with them

* Build incentive programs, contests, bonuses, and commission structures to increase creator output

* Reactivate creators who have stopped posting or generating sales



### Campaign and Content Strategy



* Develop creator campaigns around product launches, promotions, seasonal events, and TikTok Shop sales periods

* Provide creators with compliant content angles, hooks, talking points, offers, and creative direction

* Review creator content and identify the formats, messaging, and angles producing the strongest results

* Coordinate with our internal creative, marketing, and compliance teams

* Ensure creators avoid prohibited, misleading, or aggressive health claims

* Stay informed about TikTok Shop policies, supplement advertising requirements, platform changes, and affiliate trends



### TikTok Shop Management



* Manage affiliate settings, product listings, commissions, creator invitations, campaigns, and promotional tools

* Monitor account health, violations, product eligibility, fulfillment metrics, cancellations, returns, and customer feedback

* Identify and resolve issues affecting creator activation, product visibility, conversion rate, or account performance

* Coordinate with TikTok Shop support when necessary

* Maintain accurate reporting on sales, commissions, creator performance, samples, and campaign results



### Performance and Reporting



You will be accountable for measurable outcomes, including:



* Number of qualified creators contacted

* Creator response rate

* Number of creators recruited

* Number of samples approved and delivered

* Sample-to-content conversion rate

* Number of active creators posting each week

* Number of creator videos published

* Affiliate-generated revenue

* Revenue per creator

* Revenue per sample

* Gross merchandise value

* Content conversion rate

* Return on creator and affiliate spend

* Growth of the TikTok Shop channel



You will provide weekly reporting outlining performance, opportunities, bottlenecks, top creators, underperforming initiatives, and next steps.



## Required Experience



* Proven experience managing TikTok Shop for a consumer product, e-commerce, wellness, beauty, or supplement brand

* Direct experience with TikTok Shop affiliate management and creator outreach

* Strong understanding of creator sourcing, product sampling, affiliate commissions, and performance incentives

* Experience managing creators from initial outreach through content publication and sales generation

* Ability to analyze creator and campaign data and make decisions based on performance

* Strong written communication, negotiation, organization, and follow-up skills

* Ability to work independently and take complete ownership of the channel

* Familiarity with supplement compliance and prohibited health claims is highly preferred

* Existing relationships with TikTok creators, creator agencies, or affiliate networks are an advantage



## Proof of Results Is Mandatory



Applicants must provide actual proof of relevant TikTok Shop experience.



Your application must include:



* The brands or TikTok Shops you have managed

* The specific responsibilities you handled

* Screenshots or recordings of results, dashboards, campaigns, creator outreach, or affiliate performance

* Revenue or gross merchandise value generated

* Number of creators recruited or managed

* Sample-to-content conversion rates, when available

* Examples of creators or campaigns you helped scale

* A clear explanation of the results you personally contributed to



Confidential information may be blurred, but the proof must clearly demonstrate legitimate TikTok Shop experience.



**Applicants who do not provide proof of actual experience and results will be automatically denied.**



## What Success Looks Like



Within the first 90 days, the successful candidate should be able to:



* Establish an organized creator outreach and sampling system

* Build a consistent pipeline of qualified creators

* Increase the number of active affiliates publishing content

* Improve the percentage of sampled creators who produce content

* Identify and scale high-performing creators and content angles

* Generate measurable and growing TikTok Shop revenue

* Provide clear reporting and take ownership of all creator-related operations



## How to Apply



Please submit:



1. A summary of your TikTok Shop experience

2. The brands or product categories you have worked with

3. Proof of your actual results

4. Your strongest TikTok Shop case study

5. The number of creators you have recruited or managed

6. Your availability and expected compensation

7. A brief explanation of how you would build and scale a TikTok Shop affiliate program for a supplement brand



Applications containing generic responses, AI-generated answers without supporting proof, or no evidence of TikTok Shop results will not be considered.

title: Airbnb Operations Lead
description:
We are a premier short-term rental management company that excels at delivering a luxury-grade experience for our guests. Because we hold our operations to hotel-standard cleanliness and rapid, high-touch communication, we are looking for a highly proactive, meticulous, and persistent Virtual Assistant to join our team.



In this role, you aren’t just answering messages; you are the operational heartbeat of our properties. We do not micro-manage. Instead, we empower diligent professionals who take total ownership of their shifts. Our ideal candidate possesses an "owner's mindset" and is relentlessly persistent - you do not let tasks slide, and you proactively follow up on every open item until it is 100% resolved.



Key Responsibilities



Rapid, High-Standard Responses: Manage the guest inbox across all platforms (Airbnb, Vrbo, Direct Booking), responding to inquiries within 5 minutes with a warm, professional, and on-brand tone.



Anticipatory Guest Support: Don't just answer questions - anticipate what the guest will need next. (e.g., If a guest asks about check-in, proactively provide parking details, local recommendations, and check-in steps before they have to ask).



Persistent Problem Resolution: Act as the first point of contact for guest issues (access codes, Wi-Fi, troubleshooting smart home tech). Own the problem from start to finish. If a local contact doesn't respond immediately, you don't wait—you follow up persistently until the guest's issue is fully resolved and confirmed.



Review Maximization & Management: Actively monitor guest sentiment mid-stay to resolve minor issues early. Respond to post-stay reviews and diligently build cases to dispute unfair reviews according to platform policies.



Flawless Turnover Scheduling: Coordinate and schedule cleaning crews daily. Double-check calendar synchronizations across all platforms to guarantee zero missed cleanings.



Quality Control Oversight: Review turnover photos and checklists submitted by cleaners with an eagle eye. Diligently flag and address any missed details (e.g., uneven bed tucks, low inventory, or missed dust) before the next guest arrives.



Relentless Maintenance Coordination: Proactively coordinate with local handymen and providers. Track ongoing maintenance tickets and persistently follow up with vendors until you have physical or photographic proof that the job is completed to our standards.



Aggressive Claims Management: Diligently document and track any guest damages. Gather photographic evidence, cleaner statements, and repair estimates. Follow up relentlessly on pending AirCover or insurance claims until reimbursement is fully approved and paid.



Listing Maintenance: Assist with administrative tasks such as updating calendars, managing listings, and refreshing local guidebooks to keep our digital presence competitive.



Qualifications & Requirements



Experience: 5+ years of direct experience in Airbnb/short-term rental property management and hospitality is strictly required.



Proactive & Persistent Follow-Through: You have a natural drive to close open loops. You do not let tasks sit on "pending" without active, continuous follow-up. You are comfortably persistent when dealing with unresponsive guests, cleaners, vendors, or support platforms.



Extreme Attention to Detail: You are someone who spots a typo from a mile away and notices when a cleaner's photo doesn’t match our standard property layout.



Superb Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English skills. You can write polished, empathetic, and grammatically perfect messages under pressure, while still maintaining a firm and professional stance when chasing down resolutions.



Software Proficiency: Highly comfortable navigating Property Management Systems (PMS) like Guesty or Hospitable, alongside turnover platforms (e.g., Breezeway) and dynamic pricing tools.



Workspace & Schedule: A reliable, high-speed internet connection with a backup power/internet solution, a quiet workspace, and the ability to work shifts aligned with US time zones.



Why Join Us?



Professional Growth: We value talent and reward proactive, high-performing team members who drive results with increased responsibility, growth opportunities, and performance-based bonuses.



Collaborative Environment: We provide documented SOPs and training, but we welcome your ideas on how to optimize and improve them.



Empowered Autonomy: We trust you to do your job. If you are diligent, persistent, and proactive, you will find a highly supportive, collaborative, and rewarding environment here.



How to Apply (Our First Attention-to-Detail & Follow-Through Test)



To prove you are the diligent and persistent professional we are looking for, please reply with:



A copy of your resume highlighting your experience managing short-term rentals.

The name of the Property Management Software (PMS) you are most comfortable using.

An example of a time you had to be highly persistent to resolve a difficult property management or guest issue.



Include the word "Detail-Oriented" in the 1st sentence of your response to us (Note: Applications that do not follow these two instructions precisely will be automatically disqualified).
