Retro Auto Detailing | Remote – Philippines



Retro Auto Detailing is a growing mobile auto detailing company serving Queens, Long Island, and select areas of Brooklyn, New York. We are looking for a confident, motivated, and results-driven Remote Sales & Fleet Outreach Representative to help us grow our residential, membership, and commercial fleet business.



This is not simply a customer service position. Your primary responsibility is to generate revenue, convert leads into paying customers, and develop new commercial relationships for Retro.



Responsibilities:

Answer inbound customer calls and inquiries professionally

Convert incoming leads into booked and paid detailing appointments

Make outbound calls to potential customers and businesses

Contact and prospect companies with vehicle fleets, including:

HVAC companies

Plumbing companies

Electrical contractors

Construction companies

Landscaping companies

Pest control companies

Property management companies

Medical transportation companies

Delivery companies

Limousine/black-car companies

Other businesses operating multiple vehicles

Identify decision-makers and introduce Retro's mobile fleet detailing services

Follow up consistently with fleet prospects until a decision is made

Reactivate previous Retro customers and encourage them to book again

Introduce qualified customers to Retro's $199 monthly membership

Follow up with customers who received quotes but did not book

Maintain accurate notes on leads, follow-ups, sales, and fleet opportunities

Coordinate with our operations team regarding appointment availability

Follow approved pricing and promotional guidelines

Meet weekly and monthly sales targets

What Success Looks Like



We are looking for someone focused on results, not simply the number of calls completed.



Your performance will be measured through:



Revenue generated

Completed and paid bookings

Lead-to-customer conversion rate

New monthly memberships sold

Previous customers reactivated

Qualified fleet opportunities created

Fleet meetings/quotes generated

Commercial fleet accounts closed

Consistent utilization of available detailing capacity



One of your main goals will be helping us consistently fill our second mobile detailing van with profitable business.



Qualifications: 

Strong spoken and written English

Confident and professional telephone communication

Previous sales, appointment-setting, telemarketing, or business development experience preferred

Comfortable making cold calls

Comfortable speaking with business owners and managers

Able to handle objections without becoming discouraged

Strong follow-up skills

Organized and able to maintain detailed lead records

Comfortable working independently

Goal-oriented and competitive

Reliable internet connection and quiet working environment

Ability to work hours that overlap with New York/Eastern Time



Experience selling services, working with U.S. customers, or conducting B2B outbound sales is a strong advantage.



Who We Want



We want someone who hears “not interested” and knows how to professionally follow up - not someone who gives up after one call.



You should be comfortable building relationships, asking for the sale, following up consistently, and working toward measurable revenue goals.



Compensation



Base compensation + performance-based incentives/commission



High-performing representatives will have the opportunity to earn additional compensation based on sales results, memberships, and commercial business generated.



About Retro Auto Detailing



Retro Auto Detailing provides convenient professional mobile detailing directly at customers' homes and businesses. We are actively expanding our recurring membership program, residential customer base, and commercial fleet division.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company as we expand.

title: Airbnb Operations Lead
description:
We are a premier short-term rental management company that excels at delivering a luxury-grade experience for our guests. Because we hold our operations to hotel-standard cleanliness and rapid, high-touch communication, we are looking for a highly proactive, meticulous, and persistent Virtual Assistant to join our team.



In this role, you aren’t just answering messages; you are the operational heartbeat of our properties. We do not micro-manage. Instead, we empower diligent professionals who take total ownership of their shifts. Our ideal candidate possesses an "owner's mindset" and is relentlessly persistent - you do not let tasks slide, and you proactively follow up on every open item until it is 100% resolved.



Key Responsibilities



Rapid, High-Standard Responses: Manage the guest inbox across all platforms (Airbnb, Vrbo, Direct Booking), responding to inquiries within 5 minutes with a warm, professional, and on-brand tone.



Anticipatory Guest Support: Don't just answer questions - anticipate what the guest will need next. (e.g., If a guest asks about check-in, proactively provide parking details, local recommendations, and check-in steps before they have to ask).



Persistent Problem Resolution: Act as the first point of contact for guest issues (access codes, Wi-Fi, troubleshooting smart home tech). Own the problem from start to finish. If a local contact doesn't respond immediately, you don't wait—you follow up persistently until the guest's issue is fully resolved and confirmed.



Review Maximization & Management: Actively monitor guest sentiment mid-stay to resolve minor issues early. Respond to post-stay reviews and diligently build cases to dispute unfair reviews according to platform policies.



Flawless Turnover Scheduling: Coordinate and schedule cleaning crews daily. Double-check calendar synchronizations across all platforms to guarantee zero missed cleanings.



Quality Control Oversight: Review turnover photos and checklists submitted by cleaners with an eagle eye. Diligently flag and address any missed details (e.g., uneven bed tucks, low inventory, or missed dust) before the next guest arrives.



Relentless Maintenance Coordination: Proactively coordinate with local handymen and providers. Track ongoing maintenance tickets and persistently follow up with vendors until you have physical or photographic proof that the job is completed to our standards.



Aggressive Claims Management: Diligently document and track any guest damages. Gather photographic evidence, cleaner statements, and repair estimates. Follow up relentlessly on pending AirCover or insurance claims until reimbursement is fully approved and paid.



Listing Maintenance: Assist with administrative tasks such as updating calendars, managing listings, and refreshing local guidebooks to keep our digital presence competitive.



Qualifications & Requirements



Experience: 5+ years of direct experience in Airbnb/short-term rental property management and hospitality is strictly required.



Proactive & Persistent Follow-Through: You have a natural drive to close open loops. You do not let tasks sit on "pending" without active, continuous follow-up. You are comfortably persistent when dealing with unresponsive guests, cleaners, vendors, or support platforms.



Extreme Attention to Detail: You are someone who spots a typo from a mile away and notices when a cleaner's photo doesn’t match our standard property layout.



Superb Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English skills. You can write polished, empathetic, and grammatically perfect messages under pressure, while still maintaining a firm and professional stance when chasing down resolutions.



Software Proficiency: Highly comfortable navigating Property Management Systems (PMS) like Guesty or Hospitable, alongside turnover platforms (e.g., Breezeway) and dynamic pricing tools.



Workspace & Schedule: A reliable, high-speed internet connection with a backup power/internet solution, a quiet workspace, and the ability to work shifts aligned with US time zones.



Why Join Us?



Professional Growth: We value talent and reward proactive, high-performing team members who drive results with increased responsibility, growth opportunities, and performance-based bonuses.



Collaborative Environment: We provide documented SOPs and training, but we welcome your ideas on how to optimize and improve them.



Empowered Autonomy: We trust you to do your job. If you are diligent, persistent, and proactive, you will find a highly supportive, collaborative, and rewarding environment here.



How to Apply (Our First Attention-to-Detail & Follow-Through Test)



To prove you are the diligent and persistent professional we are looking for, please reply with:



A copy of your resume highlighting your experience managing short-term rentals.

The name of the Property Management Software (PMS) you are most comfortable using.

An example of a time you had to be highly persistent to resolve a difficult property management or guest issue.



Include the word "Detail-Oriented" in the 1st sentence of your response to us (Note: Applications that do not follow these two instructions precisely will be automatically disqualified).

title: Senior Online Reputation Management (ORM) Specialist
description:
We are looking for an Elite-level Internet Reputation Management (ORM) Specialist with proven experience handling difficult and high-profile online reputation cases. We work with high-profile individuals, including celebrities, executives, public figures, and brands, and we need someone who understands how to handle reputation issues that can spread rapidly across the internet.



This is not a traditional SEO or social media position.

We are looking for someone experienced in advanced content removal, search suppression, de-indexing, takedown coordination, and reputation recovery.



To give you a better understanding of the type of cases we handle:

Imagine a high-profile celebrity such as Beyoncé has an embarrassing i
 during a live performance. Someone records the i
, uploads the video, and within hours the footage is being reposted across Google, social media, news websites, and other platforms. We are looking for a specialist who understands how to approach a situation like this and legitimately pursue removal of the original and replicated content wherever possible, while also addressing the resulting search visibility. This is the level of complexity and urgency we are looking for—not simply removing a negative review or improving a Google ranking.



Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute advanced ORM strategies

- Identify the source and spread of damaging content

- Pursue legitimate content removal and takedown opportunities

- Evaluate available Google and platform removal processes

- Develop search-suppression strategies when removal is not possible

- Coordinate with publishers, platforms, and legal counsel when appropriate

- Develop authoritative content to strengthen positive search results

- Monitor Google rankings, indexing, and search visibility

- Provide regular reports and recommendations



Experience with several of the following is strongly preferred:

- Advanced Online Reputation Management

- Viral or high-profile content removal

- Search-result suppression

- Google de-indexing and removal processes

- Website and platform takedowns

- Legal/policy-based removal requests

- Technical SEO

- High-authority content publishing

- Reputation management for celebrities, executives, or public figures

- Complex cases involving news websites, social platforms, government websites, court records, or other authoritative sources



We are not looking for someone who only has basic SEO, backlink building, keyword research, or Google review management experience. We need someone who has actually handled complex ORM cases and can demonstrate real results.



To Apply, please provide:

- Your ORM experience

- Examples of difficult cases you have handled

- Results you achieved

- Your experience with content removal, de-indexing, or search suppression

- Case studies, screenshots, or other proof of results where possible



If you have experience handling high-profile, viral, or difficult online reputation problems, we want to hear from you.

Successful candidates may have the opportunity to work with us on a long-term basis, with potential for a full-time position.

title: Chat Support VA – UGC Campaign Inbox | $1,200/Month
description:
ABOUT US



We are a US LLC / American software company. We run UGC creator campaigns on SideShift (a third-party creator platform). SideShift is not our product, we use it to recruit and message creators for our campaigns.



We are hiring 2 full-time Chat Support VAs. You will not invent strategy. You will not run ads. You will work from our scripts, stay online during your shift, and get back to creators fast.



A manager will oversee you. You will be trained on a call with 2 managers. We provide all scripts, SOPs, and logins.



THE ROLE



Your job is simple and high-volume:



1. Review creator applications on SideShift and accept or reject them using our criteria

2. Answer creator DMs and messages using our scripts

3. Keep the inbox at or near zero during your shift

4. Flag anything unusual to your manager (payment issue, something not in the script)



You are the front line. Creators judge our campaigns by how fast and clearly you reply.



SCHEDULE



- Start date: Monday, August 17, 2026

- 8 hours per day

- Every day, including weekends (7 days a week)

- 56 hours per week

- Flexible start time, but your shift must cover US hours or close to US hours

- Ideal coverage: US morning through afternoon (exact window set with your manager)

- You must be reachable on WhatsApp during your entire shift

- This is not a Monday–Friday job and not a “check messages twice a day” job



PAY



- $1,200 USD per month ($5/hour)

- Paid weekly (Bank Wire)

- 1-week paid trial before we confirm the full-time seat



WHO THIS IS FOR



Must-haves (do not apply if you miss these):



- C1+ English. Spoken and written English must sound natural to a US creator. No “Good day, I hope this message finds you well”

- Fast. Typical reply target: under 15–30 minutes during your shift

- Can work every day, including weekends

- Comfortable working US hours, or close to US hours.

- Reliable internet and a quiet workspace

- Can follow a script exactly, then sound human while doing it

- Honest about availability. If you disappear mid-shift, this will not work



Nice to have:



- Prior chat support,
/Instagram DMs, 
, or community inbox work

- Experience reviewing applications or marketplace listings

- Experience with UGC, influencer, or creator platforms (SideShift, insense, #paid, etc.)



WHO THIS IS NOT FOR



- People looking for a creative, marketing, or “UGC strategist” role

- People who need 2–3 hours to reply

- People who rewrite the script into their own version

- People who can only work Monday–Friday

- People who cannot work US hours



HOW WE HIRE



1. You apply here with the instructions below

2. We shortlist from your English intro video

3. Interview 

3. Training call with 2 managers

4. 1-week paid trial on the live inbox



TO APPLY



In the FIRST LINE of your application, write: CAMPAIGN INBOX



Then send a 60–90 second introduction video of you speaking English. Phone video is fine. No script, no slides, no reading.



In the video, say:

- Your name

- That you can work 8 hours every day, including weekends, during US hours

- Why you are a good fit for a fast inbox job



Applications with no code word or no video will not be read.

description:

We specialise in e-retailing our own brand of health supplements to a global audience. We strive to create value and make a positive difference in the world, one life at a time. title: Customer Support with Full stack development skills - no graveyard shift
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



This is a dedicated role for one of our clients — a retail storefront based in Singapore. We're a Singapore-based software and automation studio, and we're hiring on their behalf.



It's a hybrid role: you'll be a friendly first point of contact for the store's customers, and you'll also bring real technical skills to keep their systems and automations running smoothly. If you enjoy helping customers and you're comfortable getting hands-on with tools like GoHighLevel, a conversational-AI chat system, and a bit of development, this one's for you.

- One of your 5 days falls on a weekend.

- No graveyard shift — these are normal daytime hours.





WHAT YOU'LL DO

.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU



- Daytime hours in your own timezone — no graveyard shifts.

No long cover letter needed.

 Flag urgent messages, reply to routine inquiries, and ensure zero critical

VIDEO EDITOR & AD CREATIVE PRODUCER (Full Time, Long Term)



This is a full time, long term position for a video editor and ad designer who wants three things: a stable job with pay that arrives on time every single time, real growth in both salary and skill, and training from people who are genuinely great at what they do.



We're a US-based advertising and lead generation company running direct response ad campaigns, and we're adding one person to own our creative production, videos and still image ads both, as we scale. Our founder owns strategy and writes the briefs. You own turning them into finished ads.



Here's what you get:



- Full time, consistent monthly pay: $800 to $1,100 USD per month depending on experience, plus 13th month pay

- Raises tied to growth. We're scaling our ad campaigns aggressively, and the people who help us get there are the first to be rewarded for it.

- Complete training and guidance. You will never be left guessing what to make. Every project comes with a script, reference ads to model, and detailed feedback, so you get better with every single ad you produce.

- Mentorship that raises your market value for life. You'll be trained directly by our founder, who has spent the last eight years running paid advertising at a high level and has overseen more than $25 million in ad spend. Very few editors ever get to learn direct response advertising from someone who's actually done it at this level.



What you'll be doing:



- Owning the creative production pipeline: every project comes with a script, a documented brief, and reference ads, and you own the execution

- Editing mobile-first video ads for
 and Instagram (vertical 9x16, captions on screen, built for sound-off viewing)

- Designing static image ads in the same direct response style, and cutting new variations of every winning ad

- Taking a brief (script, reference ads, footage) and turning it into a finished ad

- Producing volume. We test constantly, so you'll be making a lot of variations every week.

- You will have FULL ACCESS to higgsfield AI credits!



We run lead generation campaigns (insurance), not ecommerce. If your experience is ecommerce, that is fine, we can teach you our world. If you have edited for lead generation, direct response, or insurance offers before, say so in your application, it is a real plus. 



The number one skill in this role is attention. The first three seconds of an ad d
 whether someone clicks or not. We need someone who understands hooks, pacing, and captions, and who knows how to keep someone watching on a phone screen instead of scrolling past. Our audience demographic is 60 and older, so clarity beats flashiness. Big readable text, clean simple pacing, nothing confusing.

- Strong editing skills in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar

- A portfolio that includes actual ads (social media ads, UGC style videos, short form content)

- Graphic design ability (Photoshop or Canva) is a big plus

title: Sales Development Representative - AI Start-Up, Melbourne, Australia
description:
Fun and Exciting opportunity

 $10USD base rate per month / $5 USD for an appointment / $15 for a close 

About FlashFillz

We're an Australian AI company solving a problem every medical booking service practice has: when a patient cancels at the last minute, that appointment slot — and the revenue with it — usually disappears.

Our system fixes that automatically. The moment a cancellation comes in, FlashFillz texts the practice's waitlist and the first person to respond claims the slot. No phone calls. No admin. No empty chair.

The platform is built, security-audited, and running in production. We're now taking it to market across Melbourne's dental and medical sector — and we're hiring our first two SDRs to help us do it.



Why this role is different

You won't be employee number 200 reading from a call centre script. You'll be one of the first two people in our sales function, working directly with the founders. The scripts you refine, the objections you learn, the process you help build — that becomes the playbook for everyone who joins after you.



We're not looking for someone to fill a seat. We're looking for two people who want to build something and grow with it.



What you'll do

Call Australian dental and medical practices from a qualified, pre-researched list — we do the list building, you do the conversations. Your job is to book qualified appointments for our Melbourne-based closers. That's it. You're not closing deals or handling contracts.



You'll log every call outcome, and that data directly shapes how we sell. When you find something that works, we roll it out to the whole team.



The path forward



This is a genuine growth role, and we'll be specific rather than vague about it. Consistently hit 20 booked appointments per week for two months and you move into a Team Lead position — training our next hires, with a share of what your team books. We're building a sales organisation, and the first two people here are the ones who'll run it.



The three skills that matter most



1. Clear, confident spoken English. You'll be speaking with Australian practice managers and receptionists every day. You need to be easy to understand, warm on the phone, and comfortable when someone is busy or abrupt.



2. Cold calling resilience. Most calls end in a no. The people who succeed in this role treat that as information, not rejection, and pick up the phone again immediately.



3. Genuine organisation. Every call logged, every follow-up scheduled, every outcome recorded accurately. Our entire sales system runs on the data you capture.



Details

Full-time, working Australian business hours (approximately 6:00am–3:00pm Manila time). Base rate plus a bonus for every appointment booked that shows up. Full training on the product and the market — you don't need healthcare experience, you need to be able to hold a good conversation. 



We have the list, you make the calls, and follow up with us, record this fun journey as we build something amazing.

We're reading every application personally, this is a really fun and exciting oppotunity

If that is not you, this ad will save us both time.



For the right person, this is the opposite of a gig. It is a long-term seat with steady work for time to come as the store portfolio grows, and you will be working with, and trained on, the latest AI tools available to a VA anywhere. Capable people get rewarded and invested in here. We just do not hold hands.



### What you will own



This is the whole job. There is no training wheels version. We give you documented systems, a full manual and macro book, and modern AI tooling. From there you run it.



- **The inbox.** Run it end to end. Personally handle anything sensitive: refunds, disputes, angry customers. Every reply that goes out is yours, and we spot-check them.

- **Refunds.** Follow our refund and remedy ladder exactly. Partial offers up to a hard ceiling; full refunds are owner-approved, always. Zero improvising. You hold the refund lever and we audit it.

- **Chargebacks and payment disputes.** Compile evidence (order records, tracking, correspondence, policy) and submit responses within 48 hours of a dispute landing. You will have done this before; tell us where.

- **Supplier operations.** Log and chase holds, address changes, cancellations, reships, lost parcels and wrong-item claims through our supplier queue, daily, until closed. Nothing sits in silence.

- **The books.** Every refund, dispute, store credit and paid replacement logged in our trackers, same day, accurately. If it is not in the sheet, it did not happen.

- **Reporting.** A short end-of-day report every shift. A Friday voice-of-customer digest: top complaint themes and what customers keep asking for.

- **Order risk.** Same-day warm confirmation
s on flagged high-value orders, escalated immediately if anything smells wrong.



### What you will be measured on



- First reply to every customer within 2 hours during your shift; overnight tickets answered in the first hour of your next shift.

- 95% of tickets fully resolved within two replies.

- Refund ladder followed exactly; zero unauthorized refunds.

- Every chargeback answered with evidence within 48 hours.

- No problem order waits more than 24 hours for a supplier follow-up.

- Trackers and end-of-day report complete every shift, no chasing.

- 99%+ of scheduled shifts covered. If life happens, we hear from you at least 2 hours before shift with a written handover.



### You are probably a fit if



You have 4+ years in e-commerce customer service and Shopify is second nature to you, not a bonus point. You have personally answered chargebacks and coordinated with suppliers on dropshipping order problems. You use AI tools every day and pick up new ones fast. Your English, written and spoken, is excellent: clear, warm and mistake-free, good enough that customers assume they are talking to a native speaker. You follow SOPs exactly, and when one seems wrong you flag it instead of freelancing around it. You communicate proactively: we hear about problems from you before we notice them ourselves. Your last clients would call you the most reliable person they have worked with, and you notice broken things and fix them before anyone asks.



### You are not a fit if



We measure output, not hours online, and our tooling raises what one hour must produce here. Not a fit: you need daily supervision, you do the minimum and call it done, you go quiet when messaged, you treat SOPs as suggestions, you improvise on refunds, you have never touched a chargeback, you have never run a Shopify store's inbox, or your recent clients would hesitate when asked about your attendance or your speed.



### How we hire, so you know upfront



A short application, a 20-minute call, one longer interview walking through your work history, and we speak with your recent bosses or clients, so answer everything as if they are in the room. Finalists do a paid trial week on real tickets, scored against the numbers above. We d
 fast in both directions: hit the numbers and you have a long-term seat; miss them and the trial is where it ends.



### Pay, hours and terms



US$4/hour, paid on time, every time. Part-time: regular daily shifts with real ticket volume from day one, and hours that grow as sales scale; at full volume we run two reps on alternating shifts. Rate reviewed against your numbers at 90 days. Long-term role with growth as the store portfolio expands.



### To apply



Write your application yourself. We use AI every day and recognise AI-drafted applications and cover letters instantly; they do not impress us, and they go straight to the bin. We are looking for genuinely capable individuals, and the reward for being one is a long-term role and real skills with the newest tools in this trade.



 
 with a subject line containing the word **PERIDOT**, and include:



1. A voice note or Loom, 60 to 90 seconds, unscripted: the angriest customer you ever handled. What happened, what you did, how it ended.

2. One number: how many scheduled work days you missed in the last six months.

3. One sentence: which AI tools you use daily, and for what.

4. One line: how many chargebacks you have personally answered, and on which platform (Shopify Payments, PayPal, Stripe, other).

5. Your CV or profile link.



Applications missing any item are not read.

title: Vendor Management & Transactional Procurement
description:
POSITION DESCRIPTION

Roles:

1. Vendor Management staff

2. Transactional Procurement staff



Company: Logic Minds

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Work From Home – Philippines-Based

Working Hours: Australian Business Hours

Reports To: Logic Minds Management





ABOUT LOGIC MINDS

Logic Minds is an Australian company committed to building long-term relationships with our customers, suppliers, and staff. We believe strong relationships are built through trust, accountability, responsiveness, and consistently delivering high-quality work from end to end.

Our aim is to create sustainable partnerships that provide value to our customers while maintaining high standards across our suppliers, processes, and services.



Logic Minds is built around five key pillars: 

Reducing our clients’ expense bases

1. Sourcing sustainable products and services that support long-term relationships

2. Never compromise on quality

3. Future-proofing company processes by implementing scalable controls and processes

4. Respect, Respond and React to all customer needs

________________________________________



ABOUT THE ROLES  

Logic Minds is seeking an experienced and proactive Vendor Management & Transactional Procurement staff to join our team in a work-from-home capacity.

This role will be responsible for managing and strengthening relationships with suppliers and vendors while ensuring Logic Minds consistently achieves the best combination of cost, quality, service, reliability, and value.

This is a hands-on role that requires someone who is highly organised, process-driven, and confident in communicating with both vendors and senior stakeholders.

The successful candidate will work closely with suppliers, internal stakeholders, customers, and senior executives to ensure vendor relationships are effectively managed, and that agreed standards, pricing, service levels, and quality requirements are consistently met.

The ideal candidate will also be comfortable working independently from home, managing competing priorities, identifying issues before they become problems, and taking ownership of finding practical solutions.



CORE VALUES

The successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate Logic Minds’ core approach in every aspect of their work:

• RESPECT

Treat customers, suppliers, colleagues, and stakeholders with professionalism and respect.

• RESPOND

Communicate promptly, clearly, and professionally.

• REACT

Take action, solve problems, and follow matters through to completion.

KEY PERFORMANCE OUTCOMES 

Success in this role will be measured by the individual’s ability to:

• Build and maintain strong, reliable vendor relationships.

• Achieve competitive pricing and measurable cost savings where appropriate.

• Maintain high supplier performance and quality standards.

• Resolve vendor and customer issues quickly and effectively.

• Ensure vendor documentation and records are accurate and up to date.

• Maintain strong communication with Australian clients, suppliers, and senior stakeholders.

• Identify and implement process improvements.

• Demonstrate strong attention to detail and accuracy.

• Consistently meet deadlines and agreed deliverables.

• Work independently while keeping management appropriately informed.

• Contribute to scalable and sustainable vendor management processes.

• Support Logic Minds’ commitment to Respect, Respond and React to customer needs.



________________________________________



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

1. Vendor & Supplier Relationship Management

• Develop and maintain strong, professional relationships with vendors and suppliers.

• Act as a key point of contact for vendor-related matters.

• Communicate regularly with suppliers to maintain strong working relationships and ensure expectations are clearly understood.

• Manage supplier queries, concerns, escalations, and service issues promptly and professionally.

• Build long-term supplier partnerships aligned with Logic Minds’ business objectives.

• Ensure suppliers understand and consistently meet agreed requirements and expectations.



2. Pricing, Quotes & Cost Management 

• Source and obtain competitive supplier pricing, quotes, and proposals.

• Review supplier pricing and identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve value.

• Assist with price negotiations and commercial discussions with suppliers.

• Compare supplier quotes and assess overall value, not simply price.

• Monitor pricing changes and identify opportunities for savings.

• Maintain accurate records of pricing, quotes, supplier agreements, and relevant commercial information.

• Support Logic Minds’ objective of reducing clients’ expense bases through effective supplier management.



3. Vendor Performance & Quality Management 

• Monitor supplier performance against agreed expectations, service levels, quality standards, and delivery requirements.

• Identify recurring vendor performance issues and implement appropriate corrective actions.

• Follow up with suppliers to ensure issues are resolved within agreed timeframes.

• Escalate significant or ongoing supplier issues to management when required.

• Maintain accurate vendor performance records and documentation.

• Ensure quality is never compromised in the pursuit of cost savings.



4. Vendor Compliance & Process Management

• Ensure vendor documentation, agreements, pricing, and other relevant records are current and accurately maintained.

• Assist in implementing and maintaining effective vendor management processes and controls.

• Ensure vendor-related procedures are followed consistently.

• Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, and risks and recommend improvements.

• Help develop scalable processes that can support the future growth of Logic Minds and its clients.

• Maintain organised and accurate vendor records and documentation.



5. Reporting & Data Management

• Maintain accurate vendor databases, spreadsheets, reports, and records.

• Prepare regular reports relating to supplier performance, pricing, costs, savings, and other relevant vendor metrics.

• Use Excel to analyse vendor data and identify trends, discrepancies, cost-saving opportunities, and areas for improvement.

• Ensure vendor information is accurate, current, and easily accessible.

• Provide management with clear and concise information to support decision-making.



6. Customer & Stakeholder Communication

• Work closely with internal stakeholders and customers to understand vendor-related requirements.

• Respond promptly and professionally to customer and stakeholder requests.

• Communicate effectively with Australian clients and senior executives.

• Manage sensitive or complex vendor and customer matters with professionalism and sound judgement.

• Ensure customer needs are respected, responded to, and acted upon in accordance with the Logic Minds values.



7. Continuous Improvement & Problem Solving

• Proactively identify opportunities to improve vendor management processes.

• Investigate issues and determine practical, sustainable solutions.

• Look beyond immediate problems to identify root causes and prevent recurrence.

• Recommend improvements to supplier processes, controls, and workflows.

• Support the ongoing development of efficient, scalable, and future-proof vendor management systems.

________________________________________



ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

The successful candidate must have:



Communication

• Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Strong professional communication and interpersonal skills.

• Confidence communicating with suppliers, customers, internal stakeholders, and senior executives.

• Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with Australian clients.



Customer Service & Australian Client Experience

• Previous experience in customer service, account management, vendor management, procurement, administration, or similar role is given a priority.

• Demonstrated experience working directly with Australian clients or businesses.

• Strong understanding of professional expectations when dealing with Australian customers and stakeholders.

• Proven ability to manage customer and supplier relationships professionally.



Excel & Data Management

• Excellent Microsoft Excel skills are essential.

• Ability to confidently manage, analyse, organise, and report on large amounts of information.

• Strong attention to detail when working with spreadsheets, pricing, supplier data, and reports.

• Ability to use Excel to identify trends, discrepancies, and opportunities for improvement.



Vendor Management

• Experience managing suppliers, vendors, contractors, or external service providers.

• Experience handling supplier communication, quotes, pricing, negotiations, performance, and issue resolution.

• Strong ability to balance cost, quality, service, and supplier relationships.

________________________________________



PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES



Essential

The successful candidate will be:

• Self-motivated – able to maintain productivity and accountability while working remotely.

• Proactive – identifies issues and opportunities without always needing to be directed.

• Highly organised – able to manage multiple vendors, tasks, deadlines, and priorities.

• Independent – comfortable working autonomously from a home office.

• Confident – comfortable communicating with senior executives and experienced business stakeholders.

• Professional – demonstrates maturity and sound judgement when dealing with customers and suppliers.



Important

The successful candidate should also be:

• A fast learner who can quickly understand new systems, processes, products, and requirements.

• A strong problem solver who can investigate issues and develop practical solutions.

• Process-driven with a strong focus on consistency and accountability.

• Highly detail-oriented with excellent accuracy when managing vendor information, pricing, documentation, and reports.

• Commercially minded with an understanding of cost, value, quality, and supplier performance.

• Adaptable and able to manage changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• A strong relationship builder who understands the importance of trust and long-term partnerships.

________________________________________



Work Requirements



Location

• Philippines

• Work From Home



Hours

• Full-time

• Monday to Friday

• Melbourne, Australia business hours

• 8:30am – 5:00pm Melbourne time (equivalent to 6:30 am – 3:00 pm Philippine time, subject to seasonal daylight savings changes)



Leave

• Holidays: 20 days paid holiday per year accrued

• Sick Leave: 10 days paid sick leave per year accrued, provided with a medical certificate

• Public Holidays: Australian Public Holidays



Equipment Required

• Reliable internet connection

• Modern computer/laptop

• Quality headset

• Quiet home office environment

• Backup internet/power supply required



Salary

o Probation 3-month period: 23,000 pesos

o After probation: 25,000 pesos

o Pay Cycle: 15th to 16th of each month, with salary paid on the 15th.

o Annual Increase: 1,000 PESO anniversary date

o Bonus: Additional Month Salary each DECEMBER (pro-rata). 

Note: 13th month bonus is only applicable to staff who are still with the company on month of December.



Put in INTERESTED in your message title to be considered.

title: Full-Time YouTube Script Writer (Amazon & E-Commerce Experience Required)
description:
KamJam Media is a growing YouTube content agency that helps coaches, consultants, agencies, and expert service businesses create educational YouTube content that builds trust, attracts the right audience, and helps generate potential clients.



We are looking for a talented **YouTube Script Writer with experience or strong knowledge of Amazon FBA and e-commerce** who wants a stable, long-term position and the opportunity to grow with the company.



As the company grows, there will be opportunities for raises, increased responsibility, and potentially moving into a Senior Writer, Content Strategist, or Content Manager position.



## About the Role



Your main responsibility will be researching and writing long-form YouTube scripts for our clients.



A large portion of the content will be related to **Amazon selling, Amazon FBA, e-commerce, product research, product launches, branding, sourcing, marketing, and growing an Amazon business.**



Because of this, you need to already understand the basics of how Amazon businesses work.



We are not looking for someone who needs to learn what Amazon FBA is after being hired.



You do not necessarily need to have owned your own Amazon business, but you should be comfortable with Amazon terminology, business models, and the challenges Amazon sellers face.



You will also write content related to business, marketing, entrepreneurship, and other educational topics.



We are not looking for someone who simply uses ChatGPT to generate a generic script.



You should be able to take a topic, client information, research, and strategic direction and turn it into a clear, interesting YouTube video that sounds natural when spoken.



The scripts should feel like they were written by the person speaking, not like an article, school essay, or AI-generated script.



## Responsibilities



* Research Amazon FBA and e-commerce topics.

* Research YouTube video topics.

* Research competitors and relevant YouTube videos.

* Write long-form educational YouTube scripts.

* Create strong hooks and introductions that make viewers want to continue watching.

* Organize ideas in a clear and logical way.

* Keep scripts interesting without unnecessary clickbait.

* Explain complicated Amazon or business concepts in simple English.

* Write scripts that sound natural when spoken out loud.

* Match the tone, personality, and speaking style of different clients.

* Use client documents, videos, interviews, and other information to understand their experience and expertise.

* Rewrite and improve scripts based on feedback.

* Fact-check important claims.

* Help develop video ideas and angles when needed.

* Meet deadlines consistently.

* Communicate clearly when you need additional information.



## Amazon Knowledge Required



You should already understand many of the following:



* Amazon FBA

* Amazon Seller Central

* Product research

* Finding and validating product opportunities

* Private label products

* Product sourcing

* Alibaba and working with manufacturers

* MOQ

* Samples and product development

* Amazon listings

* Keywords and listing optimization

* Amazon PPC

* Product launches

* Reviews and rankings

* Inventory management

* Amazon fees

* Profit margins

* Brand Registry

* UPC / GTIN / FNSKU basics

* Shipping inventory to Amazon

* Amazon marketplaces

* Common problems Amazon sellers experience



You do not need to be an expert in every area.



However, you should understand the Amazon FBA business model well enough that you can research a topic and write intelligently about it without needing every basic concept explained to you.



## Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who:



* Has strong knowledge of Amazon FBA and e-commerce.

* Has excellent written English.

* Has experience writing YouTube scripts or long-form online content.

* Understands how to keep viewers interested throughout a YouTube video.

* Can research unfamiliar topics independently.

* Can separate good information from inaccurate or outdated information.

* Can understand a business, offer, and target audience before writing.

* Can write conversationally instead of sounding formal or robotic.

* Can adapt their writing style to different people and brands.

* Is detail-oriented and organized.

* Can follow instructions and writing guidelines carefully.

* Is comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions.

* Is dependable and consistently meets deadlines.

* Is a self-starter who does not need constant supervision.

* Is interested in learning more about YouTube, Amazon, e-commerce, marketing, and business.



Previous experience working for an **Amazon seller, Amazon agency, Amazon coach, e-commerce company, or Amazon-related YouTube channel** is a major advantage.



## Important



Using AI tools such as ChatGPT for research, brainstorming, outlining, or improving your work is completely fine.



However, we are **not looking for someone who copies a prompt into AI and submits the result.**



You must be able to think critically, research, fact-check, improve ideas, and make the final script sound natural and specific to the client.



This is especially important with Amazon content because rules, strategies, fees, and platform features can change.



Strong research and writing judgment are more important than simply producing words quickly.



## Position Details



* Employment Type: Full-time

* Hours: Approximately 40 hours per week

* Location: Remote

* Long-term position

* Opportunities for raises and promotions based on performance

* Exact schedule and compensation will be discussed during the interview



Performance will be evaluated based on:



* Quality of writing

* Understanding of Amazon and e-commerce

* Ability to match the client's voice

* Research quality

* Ability to follow directions

* Speed and efficiency

* Communication

* Reliability

* Ability to improve based on feedback



## How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your writing experience.

2. A link to your portfolio or writing samples.

3. Two or three examples of YouTube scripts you have written.

4. Any Amazon, e-commerce, business, or marketing content you have written.

5. Describe your experience with Amazon FBA.

6. Have you ever worked for an Amazon seller, Amazon agency, e-commerce business, or Amazon-related creator? If yes, explain what you did.

7. Tell us whether you currently use AI tools such as ChatGPT in your writing process and how you use them.

8. How long does it normally take you to research and write a 10–15 minute YouTube script (4-6 pages)?

9. What is your expected monthly salary for a full-time position?

10. Why are you interested in working with a growing company long term?



### Please answer these two questions in your application:



**1. What makes a YouTube script different from a blog article?**



**2. In simple terms, explain the difference between an Amazon FBA private-label seller and an Amazon reseller.**



Applications that do not answer both questions may not be considered.



Selected candidates may be asked to complete a short **paid writing test** before receiving a final offer.

title: Remote Solar Appointment Setter / Lead Manager
description:
Remote Solar Appointment Setter / Lead Manager



We’re hiring a part-time Solar Appointment Setter / Lead Manager to call and text homeowner leads and book phone appointments for our sales team.



Pay: $6–$12/hour + performance bonuses/commission

Hours: 2–4 hours/day to start

Days: Monday–Friday, Saturdays optional



About 75% of your time will be spent making outbound calls.



The other 25% will include texting leads, booking and confirming appointments, updating our CRM/Google Sheets, dispositioning leads, following up with no-shows, and rescheduling missed appointments.



Most leads that you will be calling are
 leads, older solar leads, and reactivation lists. They are warmer than completely cold lists, but this is still difficult outbound sales work. 



You will get rejected, ignored, hung up on, and told no. You need grit, thick skin, persistence, and the ability to keep dialing regardless of how the last call went.



What We're Looking For:



Experience with any of the following is strongly preferred:



* Solar appointment setting or sales

* Cold calling / outbound sales

* Appointment setting

* Calling U.S. homeowners

* GoHighLevel or similar CRMs



You must have excellent spoken English, clear neutral pronunciation, a strong phone presence, reliable high-speed internet, a quality headset, and a quiet work environment. I cannot stress enough you MUST have very strong english with barely any accent. You need to sound almost American or close to it. 



You'll use Wave Dialer, manual calling, GoHighLevel, Google Sheets, SMS, and Google Calendar.



Schedule:



Choose your hours within our preferred Central Time calling windows:



8:30–10:30 AM

11:30 AM–1:30 PM

4:00–7:30 PM



We're starting at 2–4 hours/day, with the opportunity for additional hours or full-time work based on performance and your preference.



How to Apply:



Please send:



- Your availability in Central Time

- Your cold-calling / appointment-setting experience

- Any solar experience

- CRMs and dialers you've used



REQUIRED: 60–90 second video



Record a short video speaking naturally do not read from a script.



In the video please tell us:



- Briefly about your previous experience that relates to this position.

- something you genuinely love outside of work. It could be your family, a person, traveling, a place, food, art, music, a hobby, or anything else. Also, why you love it and how it makes you feel:)



Call Recording: If you have a recording of yourself making calls from a previous cold-calling, sales, or appointment-setting position, please attach it as well.



We're looking for someone who can dial consistently, handle rejection, communicate naturally, stay organized, follow up relentlessly, and produce appointments. 



Excited for you to join this growing opportunity and work 1 on 1 with me not some big corporate position or company. You will be my right hand in this and we will talk mostly every day!

title: VIDEO EDITOR
description:
Video Editor Wanted (Long Form + Social Content)



We're building a team of elite freelance video editors who thrive under deadlines and know how to turn great content into content people actually watch.



This is **not** a beginner editing position.



We're looking for someone who understands storytelling, pacing, color, sound, and how to create viral moments from long-form content.



## What You'll Be Editing



* Podcast episodes

* Interviews

* Behind-the-scenes content

* YouTube videos

* Brand documentaries

* Event recap videos

* Social media clips (Instagram, TikTok,
, YouTube Shorts)



## What We're Looking For



### Must Have



* Strong experience editing **long-form content** (30–90+ minutes)

* Ability to identify engaging moments and create multiple short-form clips from a single edit

* Professional color correction and color grading

* Clean audio editing (EQ, noise reduction, leveling)

* Fast turnaround times without sacrificing quality

* Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, and viewer retention

* Organized project management and file handling

* Excellent communication



### Bonus Skills



* Motion graphics

* Animated captions

* Sound design

* Thumbnail design

* Experience with podcasts or multi-camera productions

* Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve (preferred)



## We Want Someone Who...



* Thinks like a content creator—not just an editor.

* Can watch a 60-minute podcast and immediately identify 10–20 viral moments.

* Understands YouTube retention and social media algorithms.

* Doesn't need to be micromanaged.

* Takes pride in making every edit feel cinematic and engaging.

* Can consistently meet deadlines.



## Deliverables May Include



* Full YouTube episode

* Multiple vertical social clips (9:16)

* Horizontal promotional clips

* Thumbnail suggestions

* Captioned versions

* Platform-specific exports



## To Apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio or demo reel.

2. Three examples of long-form videos you've edited.

   * A 60-minute podcast

   * Five social clips

6. Your hourly rate or per-project pricing.

7. Tell us what makes a great YouTube edit in your opinion.



### Bonus



If you've worked with podcasts, creators, brands, musicians, or documentary-style content, we'd love to see it.



---



We're looking for someone who wants a long-term relationship—not just a one-off project. If you're fast, reliable, creative, and consistently deliver high-quality work, there will be ongoing work every month.



If you're the type of editor who watches content thinking, **"I already know the five clips that would go viral,"** you're exactly who we're looking for.

title: Part-Time Project & Operations Virtual Assistant (Home Service Company)
description:
Part-Time Project & Operations VA for a U.S. Home-Service Company (Fast, Independent, Follows SOPs to the Letter)



Company: American Dream Pressure Clean, a growing U.S. (Florida-based) exterior and pressure-washing company

Type: Part-time, 25 to 30 hours/week, long-term

Schedule: Must overlap U.S. Eastern Time business hours (we will align on a set daily window)

Pay: $6 to $8/hour depending on experience, with room to grow for the right person, plus performance bonuses

Start: As soon as we find the right fit



READ THIS WHOLE POST BEFORE APPLYING

We run on systems and SOPs. Following instructions exactly, the first time, is the single most important trait for this role. The application steps at the bottom are part of the test. Applications that skip them will not be reviewed. (This is on purpose; it saves us both time.)



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are a small, systemized home-service business. Our day-to-day customer flow is light (only a few new leads a day), so this is NOT a phones-all-day customer-service seat. This is a project and operations role. The bulk of your week is executing projects that move the business forward, with a small amount of customer communication mixed in.



You will own projects from start to finish: we hand you a documented process or a Loom video, you follow it precisely, work quickly, and come back with it DONE, not half-done and full of questions. When something is unclear, you ask the right question up front instead of guessing.



We use AI tools (ChatGPT / Claude) heavily to speed up and build workflows, and we want someone excited to use them too.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO (PROJECT-HEAVY)

- Execute 2 to 3 project tasks per day from our master plan and report progress clearly

- Build and improve simple workflows and automations (Zapier, CRM automations, AI-assisted processes)

- Create marketing assets: flyers, before/after graphics, postcards and EDDM designs (Canva) and short video edits (CapCut)

- Keep data clean and accurate: KPI dashboards, lead tracker, reporting cleanup (Google Sheets)

- Manage social and local SEO tasks: Google Business Profile posts,
 and Instagram, review responses, geo-tagging

- Light customer communication as needed: responding to leads by text and
, follow-ups, scheduling in our CRM (Markate)

- Vendor and contractor research projects (comparing tools, sourcing creators and subs, etc.)



WHO YOU ARE (THIS MATTERS MORE THAN THE TOOL LIST)

- Fast. You finish a 30-minute task in about 30 minutes, not an hour. Efficiency is something you take pride in.

- Independent. You can take a documented process and run it end-to-end without being chased or re-explained to.

- A precise instruction-follower. You do 100 percent of an SOP, not 80. Small details (subtitles, correct pricing, the last step) do not get dropped.

- Great at juggling. You can hold several projects at once without letting things slip through the cracks.

- Proactive. You flag problems early with context and ask smart questions before acting on something unclear.

- Detail-oriented. You catch your own mistakes before they reach the manager.



EXPERIENCE AND TOOLS

Required:

- 2 or more years as a VA, operations, or project assistant, ideally for a U.S.-based service business

- Strong written and spoken English (you will occasionally talk to U.S. customers)

- Comfortable with Canva and basic video editing (CapCut or similar)

- Comfortable in Google Sheets and learning a CRM

- Confident using ChatGPT or Claude to work faster

- Reliable computer, fast internet, and a power and internet backup plan



Nice to have (call these out if you have them):

- Experience with a field-service CRM (Markate, Housecall Pro, Jobber, ServiceTitan, GoHighLevel, etc.)

- Zapier or automation building

- Meta and
 Ads

- Home-service or exterior-cleaning industry experience

- Local SEO or Google Business Profile experience



WHAT WE OFFER

- Long-term, stable part-time work with a supportive owner

- Real ownership of interesting projects (not mind-numbing data entry all day)

title: Closara: Performance Creative & Media Buyer
description:
Performance Creative & Media Buyer: Ad Editor Who Thinks Like a Marketer 



We're hiring an ad editor who thinks like a marketer:

We run a pay-per-lead model: we generate customer opportunities on
, Instagram and Google with paid ads. The single most important skill in that machine is yours: editing. You study industries and consumer psychology and package it into a high volume of ad creative that makes people click and buy. Great editing takes years to build — that's the craft we're hiring. The media buying behind it can be trained, and we will train you: step-by-step, exactly which buttons to press. If you already have media-buying experience, that's a major plus — but the editor is who we're hiring.

This is a partnership, not a task job — direct mentorship, SOPs, and the room to grow into leading the creative and media team as we scale.



Compensation: USD $1,000–$1,500/month base (for the right person — we pay for a weapon) + 1% uncapped performance commission.

Type: Full-time, work from home, long-term.

Hours: ~8 hours/day plus a lunch break. Start between 9:00–10:00am Philippine time (11:00am PHT at the latest) — e.g. 10am–7pm PHT. You'll overlap Melbourne (AEST) afternoon/evening, with a short daily check-in at the start of your day after you send a morning brief. Then a sharp concise EOD report. 



What You'll Do:

Creative — your craft, most of the week

-Edit a high volume of short-form video ads for Meta, Instagram and YouTube — hooks, angles, variations. Volume of tested creative is our #1 lever, so you ship in batches.

-Produce static image creatives, including AI-generated statics (Nano Banana or similar).

-Build AI ad videos with tools like Kling, Veo3, Seedance, Higgsfield, kie.ai.

-Study the industries and the psychology — what makes people click and buy. Pitch angles and concepts; think for yourself, don't just cut what you're told.

Media buying — where this role grows (we train you)

-Learn to launch, test, kill and scale the Meta/Google campaigns behind your creative to a target cost-per-lead — with full training, SOPs and videos on exactly what to do.

-Read the data and feed what the numbers say straight back into the next batch of creative — the creative-to-CPL loop is yours to own over time.

-You don't need to be a fancy, elite editor — in advertising, clean and minimal converts. What matters is creativity, marketing instinct and speed.



You're Our Person If You Have

The one hard requirement:

A portfolio of ad creative you've personally edited — video and static. This is the gate. No portfolio, no application. Editing at this level takes years to build, and it's the skill we're hiring.



-Real video editing (CapCut / Premiere / After Effects) and static design — 3+ years of reps behind you.

-Fluency with AI creative tools — image and video generation — to move fast.

-A performance / lead-gen mindset (CPL / CPA) — NOT TikTok-influencer or brand-awareness content.

-Fluent written and spoken English.

-Full-time, single focus — no other clients on the side.

-Highly preferred — major points

-Media-buying experience — Meta / Google / YouTube. If you've personally run an ad account, show it (real CPL and spend). -Any performance-marketing experience counts strongly here. Don't have it yet? Still apply — we train the buying; we can't train the years of editing.

-Experience across multiple verticals; strong grasp of consumer psychology and direct-response.



Not This Role

So we're clear (and so the right people self-select): funnel building, GoHighLevel automation, landing pages and cold outreach are handled by others. You focus on creative and the ads. That's the whole job — done exceptionally.



Commission — How It Works

On top of base, you earn 1% of the collected margin on the client revenue your campaigns drive, every month that client stays. Uncapped.

-Example: a lead-buyer client spending $50k/month at ~40% margin ($20k) = $200/month to you while they're active. Ten of those = $2,000/month recurring, on top of base.

-A smaller $2,500/month client = $25/month, which stacks at volume.

These are illustrations of the mechanism, not a promise — but the ceiling is uncapped, and it's built to grow well beyond the base as we scale.



How To Apply:

Read carefully — we get over a thousand applications and skipping a step means instant deletion.

1. Start your message with the word VESICA so we know you actually read this.

2. Your portfolio — a Google Drive folder set to “anyone with the link,” showing ad creative you've edited (video + static).

3. THE TEST — build us one Closara ad. Look at our website (closara.co) and create a single ad (a static image OR a short video) for Closara. Show us your creative and the thinking behind it (the angle, the hook, why it would work). This is the main thing we'll judge.

4. If you have media-buying experience (major points): link or screenshots of an ad account you've personally run, showing real cost-per-lead and spend. No account? Skip this step — it won't delete you.

5. A short Loom introducing yourself in English. We don't care about production quality — we want to see you're serious.

6. One or two sincere lines: the best CPL or best-performing ad you've made, and why you want this role. Confirm your PHT hours and that you can commit full-time.



Show us a real portfolio and a Closara ad that makes us stop scrolling — and you'll hear from us fast.

title: AI & Systems Integration Specialist
description:
Cooper Roofing Inc.

AI & Systems Integration Specialist



Location: Remote (Philippines preferred). Applicants must maintain at least three hours of overlap with Vancouver business hours. Five to eight hours of overlap is ideal.



Connect the Systems That Will Power Our Growth



Cooper Roofing is an award-winning residential, commercial, and builder-focused roofing company serving Greater Vancouver and the Lower Mainland. We believe a modern roofing company should be organized, technology-driven, and committed to continuously improving the experience of both its customers and employees.







Our business currently operates across more than 20 software platforms, and many integration and automation decisions are still managed directly by our Founder and CEO. As we work toward our goal of becoming a $10 million company, we need a technical specialist who can connect our systems, eliminate unnecessary manual work, and build a scalable technology foundation.







The AI & Systems Integration Specialist will take ownership of Cooper Roofing's technology stack from end to end. This is not a general virtual assistant position and is not intended for a marketer who has only built a few basic Zapier automations. You will serve as the architect responsible for understanding how our systems, workflows, teams, and data connect. You will audit our existing tools, interview employees about their daily processes, identify inefficiencies, recommend consolidation opportunities, and build reliable integrations using platforms such as Zapier, 
, and n8n. The role reports directly to the Founder and CEO and works closely with the Marketing Strategist, web developer, and employees throughout the company.







Key Responsibilities



Create and maintain a complete inventory of company software, including each tool's purpose, owner, cost, data, and integrations.

Meet with employees across sales, estimating, administration, production, project management, marketing, and leadership to document workflows and pain points.

Recommend which tools should be retained, replaced, consolidated, or eliminated.

Establish and protect a reliable source of truth for customer and job data within JobNimbus, GoHighLevel, or the appropriate system.

Build and maintain integrations using Zapier, 
, n8n, APIs, webhooks, and custom workflows.

Monitor automation health and resolve failed Zaps, scenarios, webhooks, and data transfers before they affect operations.

Develop AI-assisted estimate and proposal drafting workflows based on job information or photographs.

Automate customer follow-up sequences based on JobNimbus stages.

Integrate call transcription and summaries with customer and job records.

Develop lead-scoring systems using historical sales and closing data.

Build AI-assisted review-response workflows that require human approval before publishing.

Automate the creation of advertising and landing-page variations for the Marketing Strategist to test.

Create content-repurposing workflows across multiple formats and platforms.

Develop scheduling-conflict alerts involving crews, weather, and material deliveries.

Automate the organization of crew photographs and documents into the correct job files.

Build material-ordering triggers connected to job stages and supplier processes.

Automate warranty, callback, and service-reminder tracking.

Connect job-completion stages with invoicing and QuickBooks workflows.

Develop alerts for duplicate invoices, unusual transactions, and other accounting anomalies.

Create automated weekly financial summaries using QuickBooks data.

Automate new-hire onboarding, account setup, documentation, and training checklists.

Build an internal knowledge base or SOP assistant that helps employees answer routine questions.

Create dashboards connecting JobNimbus, QuickBooks, advertising spend, leads, and closed revenue.

Develop proactive alerts for changes such as rising cost per lead, declining close rates, or unusual performance.

Manage integration credentials and access through a shared password manager.

Maintain process maps, system documentation, SOPs, and written offboarding procedures.





Qualifications



Previous experience in IT administration, systems administration, technical operations, automation engineering, or systems integration.

Hands-on experience with at least two of the following platforms: Zapier, 
, and n8n.

Strong preference for candidates with practical n8n experience.

Experience administering a CRM rather than simply using one.

Experience with GoHighLevel, JobNimbus, or a comparable CRM is preferred.

Comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, authentication methods, and JSON.

Ability to create custom integrations when a native connector is unavailable.

Experience connecting QuickBooks or another accounting platform with operational systems.

Experience managing or improving a multi-platform technology stack.

Strong documentation habits and the ability to create clear SOPs and process maps.

Excellent written English and the ability to explain technical processes to non-technical employees.

Strong attention to security, credential management, data accuracy, and access controls.

Direct experience using OpenAI, Anthropic, or another large-language-model API is an asset.

Ability to work independently, investigate technical problems, and recommend solutions based on cost, complexity, reliability, and business value.





Pay and Benefits



Full-time independent contractor position.

Base salary: USD $1,000-$1,500 per month, paid bi-weekly, depending on technical experience, systems integration expertise, and demonstrated ability 

Thirteenth-month bonus for candidates based in the Philippines; an equivalent structure may be discussed for candidates located elsewhere.

Direct working relationship with the Founder and CEO.

Significant ownership of the company's technology and automation strategy.

Opportunity to design systems that will support Cooper Roofing's growth.

Exposure to systems across sales, marketing, estimating, production, finance, human resources, and customer service.

Ongoing professional development within a company that values learning and continuous improvement.

Final candidates may be invited to complete a paid technical assessment as part of the hiring process.

Applicants must be able to consistently provide at least three hours of overlap with Vancouver business hours, with five to eight hours being ideal. Because this position will have near-administrator access to important company systems, finalists should also expect comprehensive reference and background checks upon a conditional offer.





Why Cooper Roofing?



At Cooper Roofing, technology is not treated as an afterthought; it is a critical part of how we plan to grow without adding unnecessary complexity and administrative work. You will have the opportunity to build systems with a visible, company-wide impact and solve meaningful operational problems across every department. We value people who take initiative, document their work, continue learning, and challenge inefficient ways of operating. This is a chance to become the trusted technical owner of a growing company's entire digital ecosystem.







Cooper Roofing encourages applications from qualified candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.



PLEASE SEND THE APPLICATION IN THE FOLLOWING LINK: CooperRoofing.discovered.ai/job-details/68615

title: Social Media Manager / Content Creator — Short-Form Video Editing + Copywriting (Full-Time)
description:
Incustudio is hiring ONE full-time Social Media Manager to own our social channels end to end.



This is not a support role. You will own the channel — strategy, production, publishing, and engagement.



------------------------------

WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

------------------------------

- Build and run the monthly content calendar (you propose it, we approve it)

- Edit short-form vertical video: Reels, TikToks, Shorts — hooks, cuts, captions, sound

- Write the copy: hooks, captions, carousel text, CTAs — in our brand voice

- Design supporting graphics in Canva

- Schedule and publish across platforms

- Run community management: comments, DMs, engagement

- Report monthly on what worked, what didn't, and what you're changing next month



------------------------------

WHAT WE REQUIRE

---------------------
+ years actually managing social media accounts (not just posting)

- 2+ years editing short-form vertical video — CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects or Final Cut

- Real copywriting ability. You can write three genuinely different angles for one video, not three rewrites of the same sentence

- Strong written English. B2 minimum, C1 or C2 strongly preferred

- Canva proficiency

- A portfolio. Links to videos YOU edited and captions YOU wrote

- Reliable internet and your own computer

- Available for at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (roughly 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM EST / 9:00 PM - 1:00 AM Manila)



------------------------------

NICE TO HAVE

------------------------------

- Motion graphics or animation

- SEO writing

- Experience with a brand or agency rather than only personal accounts

- Analytics: you can read the numbers and change the plan because of them



------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY — READ THIS CAREFULLY

------------------------------

Applications that skip these steps will not be reviewed.



Start your application with the word GREENLIGHT so I know you read the whole post.



Then send:

1. Links to 3 short-form videos you personally edited

2. 3 captions you wrote that you are proud of — with results if you tracked them

3. What you cut in, and how long one 30-second vertical takes you end to end

4. Your expected monthly rate for full-time work



------------------------------

OUR HIRING PROCESS

---------------------
. You apply with the above

2. Short call if it's a fit

3. A small PAID test project — a real clip of ours, paid at your rate. We do not ask for free work

4. Offer



Long-term, full-time role. We are looking for someone to grow with us, not a one-off project.

title: Short Form Video Scriptwriter / Copywriter
description:
Hiring a Short-form Video SCRIPTWRITER — remote, full-time, paid in USD



I run a short-form content agency and I'm looking for a dedicated scriptwriter to join as a full-time member of the team.



This is not a one-off gig. I'm looking for someone who wants to grow with an agency long-term.



What you'll be doing:

— Writing conversion-driven video scripts. These are authority-based content for personal brands, including top-of-funnel, middle-funnel, and bottom-of-funnel video scripts. Mostly talking-heads.

— Similar to Alex Hormozi / wizofecom / Mino Lee styles 

— Writing filming briefs for the scripts you created

— Input on performance review, content strategy, iterations, etc



What I offer:

— Full-time, remote

— Working directly with US clients

— Room to grow as the agency scales

— Fixed base pay + Monthly bonus based on customer feedback, quality, and number of scripts produced



Requirements:

— Portfolio REQUIRED — no portfolio, automatically rejected

— You must have written specfically video scripts before - SEO blogs, tweets, LinkedIn posts, and copy written to be read vs. filmed in general DO NOT count

— Must be available 9 PM – 5 AM PHT (9 AM – 5 PM Eastern)

— Minimum 1 year of experience

— Must be ready to start immediately

— Must have your own equipment and reliable internet

— Good taste and judgment are a must.



Who we are looking for:

You should be very scrappy, driven, and adaptable.



If you're expecting a corporate setup where you come in and there's a lot of hand-holding — a step-by-step SOP for everything — this is not the right fit. 



This is going to be a lot of figuring things out. You need to be able to think and solve problems on your own while they're being thrown at you.



- High pressure tolerance

- Tight deadlines

- Always-changing environment



You'll of course have clear expectations, communication, and support from the team, but a lot of problems will get thrown at you with no existing process. A lot of tasks will start with just your own process, and over time they turn into SOPs so that things get easier in the long run.



The founder is super involved, and it's a very tight team.



The work environment is very scrappy and fast paced, and will only resonate with you if:



- You have a strong purpose in life

- You're genuinely interested in copy, writing, videos, or related areas



AND only if you hold these values:



- Honesty, integrity

- Actually great at what you do

- Genuinely hard-working

- Always looking to improve



—



Please dm or
 me 
 with:

1. Your portfolio,

2. A quick intro,

3. Your salary expectation range (minimum and ideal),

4. And tell me which of the three reference accounts above matches your style the most.



Thanks,

title: CFD Modeller (WFH)
description:
CFD Modeller – Building Services & Smoke Control



About the Role



We are seeking an experienced CFD Modeller with expertise in building airflow, thermal analysis, and smoke management systems.



The role will involve undertaking advanced Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) modelling to assess mechanical airflow systems, temperature distribution throughout buildings, smoke movement, and smoke exhaust performance. You will work on a variety of commercial, industrial, residential, and specialist projects requiring detailed performance-based analysis and engineering solutions.



Key Responsibilities

Develop and analyse CFD models for building airflow and ventilation systems.

Undertake smoke movement and smoke exhaust modelling.

Perform temperature and heat transfer analysis throughout buildings.

Assess HVAC and mechanical ventilation performance.

Model smoke hazard management systems, stair pressurisation systems, and atrium smoke control systems.

Interpret simulation results and provide engineering recommendations.

Prepare technical reports and supporting documentation.

Work closely with engineers, consultants, contractors, and clients to develop practical solutions.



Skills & Experience

Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Fire Safety Engineering, Building Services Engineering, or similar.

Proven experience in Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) modelling.



Strong understanding of:

Airflow and ventilation systems

Smoke control and smoke exhaust systems

Building thermal performance

Heat transfer and fluid mechanics

Mechanical services design

Preferred Software Experience



Experience with one or more of the following:

ANSYS Fluent

FDS (Fire Dynamics Simulator)

PyroSim

OpenFOAM

STAR-CCM+

SimScale

Similar CFD modelling platforms



Desirable Experience

Performance-based design and analysis.

Fire engineering and smoke management projects.

NCC and Australian Standards compliance.

Commercial, industrial, healthcare, education, or mixed-use developments.



What We're Looking For

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work independently and manage projects.

Excellent technical report writing skills.

Confidence communicating complex modelling outcomes to technical and non-technical stakeholders.



To Apply



Please submit your CV link along with details of:

CFD software proficiency

Relevant project experience

Availability



Candidates with direct experience in smoke exhaust modelling, smoke movement analysis, and building airflow simulations are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Sales Assistant - Product Demo and Client Engagement
description:
About the Role

We’re an AI-driven platform helping modern clinics streamline front-desk operations through voice automation, smart call routing, and integrated booking workflows. As we expand rapidly, we’re looking for a Sales Assistant to help run live demos, engage prospective clients, and support the sales journey.
