Send your CV and a short cover letter explaining why you’d be a great fit. If you’ve done sales demos or client presentations before, feel free to share a sample or video link.

title: Customer Success & Retention Manager – $2,000 p/m + Uncapped Commission
description:
Full-Time | Long-Term Role



SALARY



- $1,500 per month during Ramp / Trial period. Upon certification (typically 30–60 days), base increases to $2,000.

- On-Target Earnings are $2,500, including a $500 performance bonus (capped).

- Commission on renewals and upsells is uncapped and paid in addition to base and bonus.

- Additional performance-based incentives may apply.



Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.



This is a long-term leadership role. You are not here to answer questions. You are here to ensure clients stay, progress, and succeed. You own retention, stability, and client momentum.



Client retention outcomes are directly linked to your performance reviews and income growth.



ABOUT US



Young Publisher – 



We are an international digital marketing company serving 4,000+ clients since 2019.



We sell an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system helping creators go viral and generate income using short-form content and AI tools.



Most clients are 45+ beginners. They are motivated but often overwhelmed. They need clarity, structure, accountability, and calm leadership.



SCHEDULE



- Full-time, 7.5 hours per day, Monday to Friday.

- You can work your hours in one block or split them, as long as you consistently meet the job requirements.

- You will serve clients during your assigned 7.5-hour shift within our main coverage window (8am ET–2am ET)

- Must attend team meetings (usually 3pm CET).



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Manage 40–50 clients after ramp-up (with systems and internal support in place).

- Run structured kickoff calls.

- Set clear expectations from day one.

- Own the client relationship end-to-end.

- Prevent churn and refund requests.

- Identify frustration early and de-escalate calmly.

- Handle difficult conversations professionally.

- Hold clients accountable to next steps.

- Follow up when clients go quiet.

- Ensure clients always know what to do next and why it matters.

- Respond within 24 hours (weekdays).

- Track progress clearly in CRM.

- Lead renewal conversations.

- Identify upsell opportunities when appropriate.

- Collect testimonials and referrals.

- Clients should never feel lost. You are responsible for clarity and momentum.



Preventable churn caused by communication gaps, missed follow-ups, or expectation mismanagement reflects on CSM performance. You are not responsible for factors outside your control.



HOW YOU WIN



- Clients stay in the program.

- Renewals remain strong.

- Refunds are rare.

- Clients feel clear and stable.

- Difficult situations are handled calmly.



REQUIREMENTS



- Near-native spoken English with very clear pronunciation for U.S.-based clients.

- Confident on Zoom.

- Strong emotional intelligence.

- Calm under pressure.

- High ownership and follow-through.

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations.

- Proactive and organized.

- Reliable internet and professional home setup.

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines.



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success or Account Management

- High-ticket program

- Knowledge of social media monetization.

- Familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, CapCut, etc.).



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here: 
/to/Su5De9Qc



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: 2D Animator & Video Editor — YouTube Long-Form Channel (Ongoing Work)
description:
About the project:

Long-form YouTube channel covering true crime, cold cases, and dark/strange history as well as educational content and interesting stories. Casual, conversational narration — like explaining a wild story to a friend, not a formal documentary. Videos run 20-30 minutes. I record my own voiceover and provide the full script; you bring it to life visually.



Style reference:

Close to the visual style of Trust Me Bro 
 specifically:



2D cutout/puppet-style character animation — thick outlines, simple round heads, swappable facial expressions — similar to "Oversimplified" or Trust me bro'' style, not frame-by-frame animation

Characters composited over real photo/stock footage backgrounds (interiors, locations, etc.)

Real photos mixed in for effect — mugshots, newspaper clippings, relevant objects

A recurring narrator character on a clean background between animated scenes

Motion graphics: animated date/text cards, comic-style speech bubbles, simple icons/effects

Fast-paced editing — jump cuts, zooms, pans, spotlight/vignette effects



What you'll be doing:



Editing raw voiceover + script into a fully animated video matching the style above

Building a reusable character rig and asset library so later videos go faster than the first

Sourcing/integrating real photos or footage where the script calls for it

Text overlays, captions, and sound effects timed to the narration

Light sound design and music mixing



Requirements:



Experience with Adobe Illustrator (character/asset creation) and After Effects (rigging/animation/compositing), or an equivalent toolset

A portfolio or reel showing cutout/puppet-style 2D animation specifically — not just basic cuts-and-captions editing

Strong English comprehension — you'll be working from a full written script

Reliable communication, able to hit a weekly deadline



Pay: $3-5/hour to start. Open to moving to a flat per-video rate once we've done a few together and have a template built.



To apply: Send a portfolio/reel, your typical turnaround time for a ~20-minute animated video, and your hourly rate.

For example, a professional organizer may be able to purchase a Client Intake Form individually, a Client Onboarding Bundle containing several related documents, or a much larger Professional Organizer Business Forms Bundle containing most of the documents needed to manage clients from inquiry through project completion.



The goal is to give customers options at different price points while also creating larger, higher-value bundles.



Your Responsibilities



You will help:



Research each business niche and determine which forms and templates business owners are actively looking for

Identify opportunities for both individual products and bundles

Create professional editable templates, primarily in Canva

Develop coordinated collections so individual products can later be combined into bundles

Create clean, attractive, easy-to-use business documents

Maintain consistent branding and formatting across product collections

Create Etsy listing images and professional mockups

Prepare customer instruction PDFs and Canva template links

Create Etsy SEO titles, descriptions, and 13 tags

Research competitors and Etsy search opportunities

Recommend new products based on demand and gaps in the market

Help organize the Etsy shop into logical sections and product categories

Help develop larger premium bundles from individual products



I want the product catalog built strategically so that one form can become several selling opportunities.



For example:



Client Intake Form ? Client Onboarding Bundle ? Complete Business Forms Bundle



This will allow us to create a large Etsy catalog while also offering customers multiple purchasing options.



The Person I Am Looking For



You should be very comfortable using Canva and have a strong eye for professional, attractive business-document design.



Etsy experience is strongly preferred, especially experience with:



Digital products

Etsy SEO

Etsy keyword research

Canva templates

Small-business documents

Printable forms

Business systems

Client onboarding materials



Strong written English is important because many of these products will contain customer-facing business language.



You should also be extremely organized. We will be creating many related products, and documents need to be designed so they can work both individually and as part of larger coordinated bundles.



I am especially interested in someone who can research, think strategically, and suggest products, rather than waiting for me to provide every idea.



Product Research Is Important



I do not want someone who only knows how to make attractive Canva templates.



I want someone who can help answer questions such as:



What forms does a residential cleaning business actually need?

What documents are photographers searching for?

What forms are selling individually on Etsy?

Which products should be combined into bundles?

Which business niches have good demand but less competition?

What important forms are competitors leaving out?

How can we create a better or more complete product?



The goal is to create products that solve real operational problems for small-business owners.



Original Work Only



All work must be original and created specifically for this shop.



I do not want:



Copied Etsy listings

Copied competitor templates

Resold PLR products

Copyrighted designs

Templates purchased elsewhere and slightly modified



Any fonts, graphics, photos, icons, or design assets used must be appropriate for commercial use.



For contracts, legal forms, waivers, or other documents that could create legal obligations, templates should be clearly presented as customizable business templates and not represented as attorney-prepared legal advice unless they have actually been reviewed by a qualified attorney.



Long-Term Opportunity



This is not intended to be a one-time project.



My goal is to build a large Etsy digital-product shop containing potentially hundreds of listings across multiple small-business niches.



The shop will include:



Individual Forms ? Small Bundles ? Client Systems ? Complete Business Bundles



If we work well together, there will be ongoing work creating additional products, adding new industries, improving listings, creating bundles, researching keywords, and expanding the shop.



I am looking for someone who is interested in helping me build and grow the business long term.



To Apply



Please include the following:



A short introduction about your experience.

Examples of Canva templates, business documents, Etsy digital products, or forms you have created.

Details about any Etsy shops you have helped create or manage.

Your experience with Etsy SEO and keyword/product research.

Your experience creating digital products.

Your hourly rate and/or project rate.

How many hours per week you are available.

Which niche you would recommend we launch first: professional organizing, residential cleaning, pet sitting, mobile detailing, photography, home staging, or event planning.

Give me 5 individual digital products you would create first for that niche.

At the very top of your application, write “DIGITAL FORMS” so I know you read the entire posting.



Please do not send a generic application.



I am looking for someone who understands how to build a digital-product catalog strategically, where products can be sold individually and then combined into increasingly valuable bundles and complete business systems.

title: Outbound Sales Representative – Real Estate Media Bookings
description:
Outbound Sales Representative – Real Estate Media Bookings



Company: Priceless Productions RE Type: Full-Time (40 hrs/week) Pay: $4.00 USD/hour base + 1% commission on all booked sales Work Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST, Monday–Friday



About Us:

Priceless Productions is a real estate media company providing photography, video, drone, Matterport, and floor plan services to real estate agents in the Richmond, VA and Northern Virginia markets. We're building out a scalable sales and marketing engine, and this role is a core part of that growth.



The Role:

We're looking for a sharp, persistent, and coachable Outbound Sales Representative to cold call real estate agents, generate interest in our media services, and book appointments/shoots directly into our pipeline. This is not a script-reading job — you'll be trained on our services, our ideal client, and our objection handling, and you'll be measured on real booked revenue, not just call volume.



What You'll Do:

-Make outbound cold calls daily to real estate agents in our two active markets — Richmond, VA and Northern Virginia (NOVA) to introduce Priceless Productions RE's services

-Qualify leads and identify agents actively listing or about to list properties

-Book photography/video/media appointments directly into our scheduling system (
 / HD PhotoHub)

-Follow up consistently with warm leads who don't convert on the first call

-Log every call outcome accurately in our CRM, including which market the booking belongs to (no exceptions — data quality is part of the job)

-Hit weekly/monthly call volume and booking targets

-Report daily/weekly activity and results to management



What Success Looks Like (KPIs):

-Calls per day: 80–100

-Appointments/bookings per week: 3–5 to start, with targets increasing as you ramp up and build rapport with our agent network

-Show-up/completion rate on booked jobs

CRM logging accuracy: 100% of calls logged same-day, tagged by market (Richmond or NOVA)



Who We're Looking For:

We want outgoing, ambitious, competitive people who genuinely enjoy sales, not someone looking for a quiet data-entry job. If you like the challenge of turning a "no" into a "yes" and want your paycheck to reflect your effort, this is for you.



Requirements:

Proven cold calling or outbound sales experience (real estate industry experience a strong plus)

Excellent spoken English with a neutral, professional phone presence

Comfortable handling rejection and staying persistent without getting discouraged

Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet work environment, and a working headset

Experience with CRM tools (
 experience a plus, but trainable)

Self-motivated — able to work independently and hit targets without micromanagement

Available for full-time hours, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST, Monday–Friday



Compensation Details:

Base pay: $4.00/hour, paid weekly

Commission: 1% of the total value of every booked sale that results from your outbound calls, paid once the job is completed/invoiced

Example: Our average job is $400–$500, so every booking earns you an extra $4–$5 on top of your hourly rate — with no cap on how many you can book. Book 5 jobs in a week and that's an extra $20–25 added straight to your paycheck.

Performance review at 30/60/90 days with opportunity for base pay increase based on results

How to Apply



Please apply with:

A short voice recording (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself in English

Your cold calling / sales experience, specifically any real estate or service-based industry experience

Your available start date



Applications without a voice sample will not be considered.

title: Roofing & Siding Takeoff Specialist

title: Experienced Video Editor
description:
About Us

We're a global wellness technology group operating multiple consumer wellness brands, including a market-leading vibration/fitness equipment brand sold across the US, UK, EU, Australia, and Canada, and a sensory/vibroacoustic therapy products brand. We also have an emerging pet-therapy brand. Our content spans YouTube, organic social across multiple brand pages, trade show media, and direct-response marketing video.



We're bringing video editing in-house and are hiring a full-time editor to own this work directly, replacing an outsourced production arrangement.



About the Role

You'll be the primary video editor across our brand ecosystem — turning raw footage, presenter recordings, and stock/B-roll into polished content for YouTube, organic social (four+ brand pages), sales funnel videos, and trade show/marketing assets. You'll work closely with our Digital Operations team and content presenters to keep a consistent, recognizable brand voice and visual identity across every platform.



This is a hands-on production role, not a supervisory one — you will personally sit in the edit chair for the majority of our video output.



What You'll Do

- Edit long-form YouTube content (tutorials, product explainers, presenter-led videos) from raw footage through to final export, including titling, pacing, and thumbnail-ready framing

- Cut short-form/social content (Reels, TikTok, Shorts) for multiple brand accounts, adapting pacing, captions, and format to each platform

- Edit presenter-led sales and funnel videos (e.g. quiz-based sales sequences) to a direct-response standard — clear structure, strong hooks, clean pacing toward a call to action

- Apply and maintain brand style guides (colour, type, lower-thirds, intro/outro, music beds) consistently across our multiple brands, using our established templates and guidelines

- Support trade show and event video content (highlight reels, product demo loops, testimonial cuts)

- Manage footage organization, version control, and a predictable delivery pipeline so stakeholders always know what's in progress and what's ready for review

- Take structured feedback from brand leadership (final creative sign-off sits with the founders) and turn revisions around quickly

- Collaborate with our content calendar/community management process to keep video output aligned with the monthly content plan



What We're Looking For

- 3+ years professional video editing experience, ideally including social-first content and at least some direct-response/marketing video

- Strong working knowledge of at least one professional NLE (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro); CapCut experience is a plus but not required

- A sharp eye for pacing and hook strength — you understand why the first 3 seconds of a Reel matter as much as the first 3 minutes of a YouTube video

- Comfort working across multiple brand identities at once without them bleeding into each other

- Experience turning long presenter recordings into tight, clean cuts without losing the speaker's natural tone

- Comfortable using AI tools in the creative workflow (e.g. AI-assisted transcription, rough-cut generation, upscaling, generative B-roll, or thumbnail/title assistance) to speed up production — but with the judgment to know when a scene needs a human eye and hand instead. We need someone who uses AI to work faster and smarter, not someone who leans on it in place of real editing skill, nor someone who refuses to use it at all

- Strong self-management — this is a remote role with a defined weekly deliverable cadence, not close supervision

- Good written English for coordinating with a distributed team (Philippines, Australia, UK, US)



Bonus: experience with health, wellness, or fitness brand content; motion graphics/basic animation skills; experience cutting trade show or event footage



Please reply with

- A reel or 3–5 links to work you personally edited (please note which pieces were your own cut vs. team output)

- A short note on your NLE experience and any direct-response/social-first video work

- A brief example of how you've used AI tools in a real edit — and, just as important, an example of where you chose not to (or a straight cut/manual edit) because AI wasn't the right call

title: Phone Support Representative — Subscription Retention
description:
Location: Remote — Philippines

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST

Philippine Time: Approximately 9:00 PM–5:00 AM PHT during US daylight saving time, shifting to 10:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT during US winter

Start Date: Immediately



> Please apply only if you can commit to the US EST night-shift schedule long term.



About the Role



We are a growing US subscription brand building our Phone Support & Retention Team from the ground up.



You'll spend your day speaking directly with American customers—many of whom are calling because they want to cancel their subscription, pause their account, or request a refund.



Your job isn't simply to read a script and process a ticket.



You'll need to have a genuine conversation, understand why the customer wants to leave, and use approved retention offers to give them a reason to stay.



When you save a customer, that's a win. When you can't, you'll professionally process their cancellation or refund while they're still on the phone, accurately and without letting a difficult interaction affect the way you treat them.



This role is ideal for someone who is confident on the phone, comfortable handling objections, and able to stay calm when customers are frustrated.



???? Growth Opportunity



This is a brand-new team, and we intend to promote our first Customer Service Manager from the people hired in this round.



If you're interested in growing into a leadership role, tell us in your application.



## What You'll Do



* Take inbound calls from US customers requesting cancellations, pauses, or refunds

* Ask the right questions to understand the customer's actual reason for leaving

* Handle objections and negotiate using approved retention offers

* Offer appropriate solutions such as:



  * Skip a shipment

  * Change subscription frequency

  * Apply an approved discount

  * Downgrade the subscription

  * Offer an approved free product

* Process cancellations and refunds directly in Shopify during the live call

* Accurately document every interaction in Zendesk

* Select the correct call outcome and reason codes

* Escalate issues quickly when they fall outside your authority

* Meet retention, refund accuracy, productivity, and call quality targets



## Requirements



Must-Have



* Fluent spoken English with clear, natural communication that American customers can easily understand

* Proven phone support experience with US customers

* Experience handling live voice calls — chat/email-only experience does not qualify

* Hands-on Shopify experience



  * Finding customer orders

  * Processing refunds

  * Managing cancellations/subscriptions

* Previous experience in customer retention, saves, objection handling, or sales

* Experience using a CRM/helpdesk platform



  * Zendesk preferred

  * Richpanel, Gorgias, or similar platforms are also acceptable

* Able to speak with customers while navigating systems and documenting information accurately

* Comfortable handling angry, frustrated, or demanding customers

* Strong attention to detail when processing refunds and cancellations

* Reliable wired internet connection

* Backup internet/power solution

* Quiet, professional workspace

* Good-quality noise-cancelling headset

* Willingness to work the required EST night shift long term



? Bonus Points



* Experience with Checkout Champ

* Experience with 
, Konnektive, ReCharge, or LimeLight

* Background working for a DTC or subscription-based brand

* Chargeback prevention or dispute handling experience

* Previous experience working specifically in **subscription retention



Who Will Do Well in This Role?



You don't get rattled when a customer says  “No.”

You know how to ask one more question without being pushy.

You don't take cancellations personally, and you don't become defensive when someone is rude.

You're able to protect company policies while still sounding like a real person - not a robot reading a script.



You know how to negotiate, listen, and identify what a customer actually needs.



And when a customer ultimately d
 to cancel, you can process the refund professionally and move on. A well-handled cancellation still protects the brand.



? This role is NOT for you if:



* You need a script for every customer interaction

* You become defensive when customers push back

* Angry customers easily overwhelm you

* You have little or no live phone support experience

* You are uncomfortable discussing cancellations, refunds, and retention

* You cannot consistently work the required US EST schedule



???? Why Join Us?



* Full-time, long-term remote opportunity

* Join a **new team from the ground up

* Opportunity for career growth into Customer Service Management

* Direct exposure to US customers and subscription operations

* Opportunity to build expertise in retention, Shopify, Zendesk, and DTC customer experience



How to Apply



Incomplete applications will NOT be reviewed.



Please include ALL of the following in your application:



1. Your Previous Experience



List the brands/companies you've worked for, including:



* Company name

* What the company sold/provided

* Your position

* How long you worked there



2. Your Refund & Cancellation Experience



Tell us:



* Have you personally processed refunds and cancellations?

* Have you used Shopify, Checkout Champ, or both?

* What were you authorized to do independently?

* What required supervisor approval?



3. ????? 60-Second Voice Recording



Submit a 60-second voice recording speaking naturally.



Tell us about a real customer call where the customer wanted to cancel but you successfully retained them.



Explain:



* What the customer wanted

* Why they wanted to cancel

* How you handled the conversation

* What you said or offered

* How the call ended



Please do not read a prepared script. We want to hear how you naturally communicate.



4. Previous Call Recordings



If you have recordings of real customer calls you've handled and are legally/permissibly allowed to share, please include them.



5. Availability



Clearly confirm:



“I am available Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST.”



6. Start Date



Tell us how soon you can start.



We are looking for candidates who can begin immediately.



---



If you're confident on the phone, know how to handle objections, and can turn a difficult cancellation call into a positive customer experience, we want to hear from you.



Apply now and tell us why you'd be a strong fit for our new Phone Support & Retention Team.

title: Trade Services Coordinator
description:
Location: Manila City, Philippines

Work arrangement: Full-time, work from home initially, transitioning to our future Manila City office



Reports to: Philippines Office Manager



About Elite Trades Australia

Elite Trades Australia is a Melbourne-based electrical and plumbing services company delivering residential, commercial, government, maintenance and energy-efficiency projects across Victoria. Our work includes electrical and plumbing services, hot-water and heat-pump installations, property upgrades, maintenance and project delivery.

We coordinate internal field teams and subcontractors through disciplined job-management, scheduling, compliance and documentation systems. Accuracy, ownership and timely escalation are essential to keeping our field operations running effectively.



About the Role



Elite Trades Australia is seeking an experienced and highly organised Service Coordinator to manage the end-to-end coordination of electrical, plumbing, HVAC and energy-efficiency works.



This is a key operational role responsible for ensuring jobs are accurately created, scheduled, dispatched, completed, documented and progressed to invoicing without unnecessary delays. The successful candidate will act as the central point of coordination between customers, field technicians, subcontractors, retailers, property managers, suppliers and internal departments.



This role requires strong ownership, excellent communication and the ability to maintain control of a busy, constantly changing schedule.



Key Responsibilities

Manage jobs from receipt of a purchase order or confirmed booking through to completion and invoice readiness.

Create accurate job cards in ServiceM8 on the same business day, including all customer, property, retailer, purchase-order and scope information.

Maintain a forward schedule and ensure work is planned efficiently according to priority, location, technician availability, trade licences, required skills and material availability.

Allocate work to employees and subcontractors while maximising productivity, travel efficiency and first-time completion.

Confirm appointments, site access requirements and job details with customers before attendance.

Provide field teams with complete job information, including scope, access instructions, supporting documents, compliance requirements and allocated materials.

Monitor daily job progress and respond promptly to cancellations, delays, access issues, technician absences, stock shortages and urgent requests.

Communicate professionally with customers, retailers, property managers, suppliers, technicians and other stakeholders.

Keep customers and stakeholders informed of appointment changes, delays, required follow-up work and expected completion timeframes.

Maintain accurate job statuses, notes, communications and supporting records in ServiceM8 as the primary operational system.

Review completed jobs to confirm that required photographs, forms, signatures, certificates, serial numbers, variations and compliance documents have been submitted.

Identify incomplete or non-compliant job documentation and follow up with field staff immediately.

Coordinate return visits, warranty matters, defects, customer complaints and outstanding works through to resolution.

Confirm stock and equipment availability with the warehouse team before scheduling work.

Record approved variations and additional works accurately and ensure they are communicated to the relevant parties.

Identify completed jobs that have not progressed to invoicing and resolve any documentation or approval issues causing delays.

Monitor overdue, pending and stalled jobs and provide management with clear updates, risks and recommended actions.

Escalate safety, compliance, customer, operational or commercial risks promptly.

Support field staff with scheduling, site information and operational issues without compromising customer service.

Assist with emergency and high-priority service requests when required.

Contribute to improvements in scheduling, customer communication, documentation and operational processes.

Maintain confidentiality and comply with company policies, safety requirements and applicable industry standards.



Key Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be measured through:

Accurate and timely creation of job cards.

Maintaining a reliable forward work schedule.

On-time attendance and job completion rates.

Efficient utilisation of field staff and subcontractors.

Accuracy of ServiceM8 records and job statuses.

Reduction in missed appointments, scheduling errors and unnecessary return visits.

Timely collection of completion and compliance documentation.

Prompt progression of completed jobs to invoicing.

Effective management of outstanding and ageing jobs.

Stakeholder response times and customer satisfaction.

Professional handling and resolution of complaints and escalations.



Skills and Experience

At least two years’ experience in service coordination, scheduling, dispatch, customer service or field-service administration.

Experience within electrical, plumbing, HVAC, construction, facilities management or another trade-service environment is strongly preferred.

Proven ability to coordinate a high volume of jobs, technicians and changing priorities.

Strong customer-service and stakeholder-management skills.

Excellent verbal and written communication.

High attention to detail and commitment to accurate recordkeeping.

Ability to remain calm, organised and solutions-focused under pressure.

Strong judgement when prioritising urgent work and escalating operational risks.

Confidence handling complaints, delays and difficult conversations professionally.

Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office and cloud-based job-management systems.

Experience with ServiceM8, AroFlo, simPRO or similar field-service software is highly desirable.

Understanding of trade licences, safety documentation and job-completion requirements is advantageous.

Experience with VEU works, compliance documentation or government-funded maintenance programs will be highly regarded.



Personal Attributes



The ideal candidate will be:

Accountable and willing to take ownership of outcomes.

Proactive rather than waiting for problems to escalate.

Highly organised and disciplined with follow-ups.

Clear, respectful and confident in communication.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced operational environment.

Focused on accuracy, customer service and continuous improvement.

Capable of balancing the needs of customers, technicians and commercial stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like



A successful Service Coordinator keeps the operation under control: technicians know where they are going and what they are doing, customers remain informed, job records are accurate, documentation is complete, problems are addressed early, and completed work progresses to invoicing without avoidable delays.

title: Virtual Assistant / Dispatcher & Executive Assistant (EST Hours: 9 AM - 5 PM)
description:
About the Company

Blueflow Plumbing is a growing commercial plumbing and property service company operating in Toronto, Canada. We service high-rise residential condos, commercial properties, and facility managers.



We are NOT looking for a passive worker who sits back and waits to be told what to do. We are seeking a sharp, highly engaged, assertive, and detail-oriented operational driver to manage our back office, field dispatch, and executive administration.



Work Schedule & Compensation

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (Eastern Standard Time / Toronto Time). Strict requirement.



Position: Full-Time (40 Hours/Week).



Salary: $2.50 – $3.50 USD / Hour ($480 – $600 USD / Month to start, with performance-based bonuses on collections and pipeline activity).



Type: Direct Hire / Long-Term.



Key Responsibilities

1. Dispatch & Live Communication (Primary Focus)

Answer inbound phone calls and SMS messages from property managers, condo boards, and tenants using our cloud phone system (Quo).



Schedule and dispatch plumbers to commercial job sites efficiently.



Create, update, and manage job tickets in our custom dispatch dashboard (AppSheet).



2. Accounts Receivable & Payment Collections

Monitor unpaid invoices and Net-30 payment terms daily.



Conduct proactive, polite, but firm phone and
 follow-ups with corporate accounting departments to ensure invoices are paid on time.



3. Executive Assistance to Owner

Manage the owner’s inbox, prioritize urgent messages, and keep calendar schedules aligned.



Coordinate procurement/orders with suppliers (e.g., Home Depot, plumbing wholesalers) as directed.



Perform administrative, personal assistant, and research tasks to free up the owner's operational time.



4. Sales & Pipeline Management

Log new commercial leads into our pipeline.



Assist in sending outbound
 inquiries to Toronto property managers and facility directors.



Requirements & Qualifications

Flawless Spoken & Written English: You will be speaking directly with Canadian commercial property managers and business owners. Communication must be clear, confident, and professional.



Assertive & Proactive Mindset: You are comfortable picking up the phone to chase overdue bills or solve scheduling conflicts. You do not panic when things get busy.



Technical Proficiency: Quick learner with cloud tools. Experience with VoIP phone systems (OpenPhone/Quo), CRM databases (AppSheet, Salesforce, or similar), Google Workspace, and QuickBooks Online is a major plus.



Reliable Setup (Non-Negotiable): High-speed internet connection, a reliable laptop/PC, a quality headset, and a backup power source (UPS/generator) in case of local power outages.



Who Should NOT Apply

Do NOT apply if you are looking for a casual, relaxed side-gig.



Do NOT apply if you dislike speaking on the phone or feel uncomfortable asking clients for payment on overdue invoices.



Do NOT apply if you cannot work full 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST shifts consistently.



How to Apply (Screening Instructions)

To show that you pay attention to detail and can follow precise instructions, reply to this posting with the subject line: "I am your next Operational Driver for Blueflow".



In your message, include:



A brief summary of your phone support / dispatch / administrative experience.



Confirmation that you have a quiet workspace, a headset, and a backup power source for EST night shifts.



A short voice note (via Vocaroo or Google Drive link) introducing yourself in English (1 minute or less).

title: Digital Marketing Strategist — SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads & Conversion Tracking
description:
# Digital Marketing Strategist — SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads & Conversion Tracking



**Remote | Part-Time to Start | Paid Trial | Long-Term Growth Opportunity**



We are looking for an experienced, dependable **Digital Marketing Strategist** who can improve our clients’ visibility, traffic, leads, bookings, and return on investment.



This is not a role for someone who only schedules ads, follows checklists, or sends automated reports. We need a strategic team member who understands how websites, SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and conversion tracking work together.



The right candidate can audit an account, identify what is limiting performance, create a clear strategy, implement improvements, and explain the results in language clients can understand.



## Your Core Responsibilities



### Website and Google SEO



- Perform technical, on-page, and local SEO audits.

- Identify issues affecting rankings, traffic, and conversions.

- Conduct keyword and competitor research.

- Improve page titles, meta descriptions, headings, content, internal links, and website structure.

- Optimize Google Business Profiles and local search visibility.

- Review website speed, mobile usability, indexing, crawlability, and overall SEO health.

- Use Google Search Console and Google Analytics to monitor performance.

- Create practical SEO recommendations and implementation plans.

- Track rankings, organic traffic, leads, bookings, and other meaningful results.

- Stay current with Google search updates and SEO best practices.



### Google Ads



- Build, manage, audit, and optimize Google Ads campaigns.

- Review keywords, search terms, match types, negative keywords, bidding, targeting, and landing pages.

- Improve click-through rate, conversion rate, cost per lead, and return on ad spend.

- Identify and reduce wasted ad spend.

- Work effectively with smaller advertising budgets.

- Recommend when campaigns should be adjusted, paused, or scaled.



### Meta Ads



- Build and manage
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.

- Develop strategies for prospecting, retargeting, lead generation, and conversions.

- Test audiences, creative concepts, placements, offers, and ad copy.

- Monitor performance and make ongoing improvements.

- Diagnose underperforming campaigns and recommend clear next steps.

- Keep up with Meta platform changes and advertising best practices.



### Analytics and Conversion Tracking



- Audit and maintain Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads conversions, and Meta Pixel.

- Check that forms, calls, bookings, purchases, and other important actions are tracked correctly.

- Identify missing, duplicated, or inaccurate conversion events.

- Test conversion tracking after website or campaign updates.

- Understand attribution and explain differences between platform-reported results.

- Maintain clean, reliable tracking so decisions are based on accurate data.

- Experience with Meta’s Conversions API is a strong plus.



### Strategy, Reporting, and Communication



- Review the entire customer journey, from search or ad click to final conversion.

- Identify problems with landing pages, offers, calls to action, forms, and funnels.

- Create clear, client-friendly reports focused on business results—not vanity metrics.

- Explain wins, concerns, and next steps in simple language.

- Communicate professionally with clients and internal team members.

- Take ownership of assigned accounts, deadlines, follow-ups, and recommendations.



## Required Experience



You may be a strong fit if you:



- Have proven experience with website SEO and Google search optimization.

- Have hands-on experience managing both Google Ads and Meta Ads.

- Understand GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Meta Pixel, and conversion tracking.

- Can independently audit websites and advertising accounts.

- Know how to diagnose poor performance and prioritize improvements.

- Understand landing-page and conversion-rate optimization.

- Are analytical, organized, proactive, and detail-oriented.

- Communicate clearly in written and spoken English.

- Can work independently without waiting for step-by-step instructions.

- Can provide examples or proof of previous results.

- Can overlap with some U.S. business hours.



## Preferred Experience



The following experience is helpful but not required:



- Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization

- Hospitality, hotel, travel, or booking-based marketing

- Call and booking conversion tracking

- Looker Studio or other reporting platforms

- Meta Conversions API

- WordPress or similar website platforms

- Managing multiple client accounts

- Maximizing results with limited advertising budgets

- Using AI tools for research, ad copy, analysis, testing, and workflow efficiency



AI experience is a plus, but you must be able to review its output, make sound strategic decisions, and produce original, accurate work.



## What Success Looks Like



A successful person in this role will:



- Catch tracking and campaign problems before the client does.

- Improve SEO visibility and qualified website traffic.

- Reduce wasted advertising spend.

- Improve the quality and cost of leads, bookings, or sales.

- Provide clear recommendations based on evidence.

- Complete work accurately and on time.

- Communicate progress without needing repeated follow-ups.

- Treat each client’s budget as carefully as their own.



## Compensation and Growth



This role will begin with a **paid trial project or trial period** so we can evaluate your technical knowledge, strategic thinking, communication, reliability, and quality of work.



Successful candidates may receive:



- Ongoing client accounts

- Recurring monthly work

- Increased responsibility

- Compensation growth based on performance, reliability, communication, and account capacity

- A long-term position within our growing team



Some clients may begin with smaller advertising budgets, so you must know how to prioritize effectively and set realistic expectations.



## How to Apply



Use the subject line:



**“I Am Your Digital Marketing Strategist”**



Please include:



1. A brief introduction and overview of your experience.

2. Your experience with website SEO, Google Ads, and Meta Ads.

3. Examples of SEO improvements or advertising results you produced.

4. The analytics, reporting, and tracking tools you use.

5. An example of a conversion-tracking problem you identified and corrected.

6. Your availability and normal working hours, including your time zone.

7. Your desired hourly or monthly compensation.

8. Screenshots, reports, case studies, or other proof of results where available.



Please begin your application with the word **“ELEVATE”** so we know you read the complete job post.



Do not send a generic or AI-generated application without specific examples of your work.



## Screening Questions



Please answer each question clearly:



1. Walk us through an SEO audit you completed. What problems did you identify, what changes were made, and what results followed?

2. How would you determine whether a website’s forms, phone calls, and bookings are being tracked correctly?

3. Describe a Google Ads or Meta Ads campaign you improved. What did you change, and what measurable results did you achieve?

4. What steps do you take when a campaign is spending money but producing few or no conversions?

5. How do you approach marketing when a client has a limited advertising budget?

6. Which SEO and reporting tools do you use regularly, and why?

7. How do you explain performance to a client who does not understand digital marketing?

8. How do you use AI in your work, and how do you verify that its output is accurate?



## Practical Strategy Question



A boutique hotel has:



- A website with low organic traffic

- An unoptimized Google Business Profile

- Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts with uncertain conversion tracking

- A limited monthly advertising budget

- A goal of increasing direct bookings



**What would you audit first, what would you prioritize during the first 30 days, and how would you measure success?**



We are looking for thoughtful, specific answers—not generic marketing definitions.



If you are a strategic marketer who understands SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and conversion tracking—and you want to grow with a long-term team—we would like to hear from you.

title: Clinical Medical Necessity & Prior Authorization Specialist (RN) - remote
description:
# Job Description: Clinical Medical Necessity & Prior Authorization Specialist (RN) – Remote



## Position Summary



We are seeking an experienced **Registered Nurse (RN)** with a strong background in **utilization management, medical necessity review, and prior authorizations** to join our growing interventional pain management and regenerative medicine practice. This is a fully remote position for a highly organized, analytical professional who enjoys reviewing complex medical records and ensuring that clinical documentation meets payer-specific medical necessity requirements.



The ideal candidate has previously worked for a **commercial insurance carrier, Medicare Advantage plan, utilization management company, or prior authorization department**, and understands how insurance reviewers evaluate requests for advanced procedures.



Rather than simply submitting authorizations, this role serves as a **clinical documentation consultant** by identifying gaps in documentation, cross-referencing payer policies, and helping providers optimize their notes before submission.



---



# Responsibilities



* Review patient charts for medical necessity prior to submission for insurance authorization.

* Analyze large medical records (100–500+ pages) and identify relevant clinical information.

* Compare provider documentation with payer-specific medical necessity criteria.

* Identify documentation deficiencies that could result in authorization denials.

* Recommend specific additions or revisions to provider documentation to strengthen medical necessity.

* Prepare comprehensive authorization packets for submission.

* Assist with first-level and second-level appeals following denials.

* Track payer-specific documentation requirements and maintain internal authorization checklists.

* Stay current with Medicare LCDs/NCDs and commercial payer policies.

* Communicate effectively with physicians, nurse practitioners, and authorization staff regarding documentation improvements.

* Maintain detailed tracking of authorization status, denials, appeals, and outcomes.

* Assist in developing standardized documentation templates to improve approval rates.



---



# Procedures Supported



Experience reviewing medical necessity for one or more of the following is strongly preferred:



* Stem Cell Procedures

* Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) Procedures

* Other Regenerative Medicine Procedures

* Pain Management Procedures



---



# Required Qualifications



* Active Registered Nurse (RN) license

* Minimum 5 years of clinical nursing experience

* Minimum 2 years of utilization management, medical necessity review, or prior authorization experience

* Previous employment with a commercial insurance company, Medicare Advantage plan, or utilization management organization strongly preferred

* Excellent understanding of medical terminology and clinical documentation

* Exceptional attention to detail

* Strong written communication skills

* Ability to work independently while managing multiple cases simultaneously



---



# Preferred Qualifications



Experience with:



* eClinicalWorks (eCW)

* InterQual Criteria



Clinical experience in one or more of the following specialties is highly desirable:



* Pain Management

title: Performance Video Editor (DTC / Paid Social)
description:
About the role



Monkedia is a fast-growing digital marketing agency, and we're looking for a Performance Video Editor who thinks like a marketer first and an editor second. This is a role for someone who understands consumer psychology and direct response, and who can turn that understanding into short-form video ads that stop the scroll and drive conversion for ecommerce brands.



We care less about polish for its own sake and more about whether you understand why an ad works: how to open on a hook that lands in the first two or three seconds, how to structure that hook both visually and through audio, how to pace a story for a specific brand, platform, and format, and how to hold attention all the way to the CTA. Ideally you've already edited video for DTC ecommerce brands, for organic social and, even better, as paid ads that ran on the Meta platform.

Strong, fast, detail-oriented video editing is the core of the job. AI is how we move faster, not the point of the role. We want you comfortable using AI video and image tools to generate B-roll, fill gaps, and produce variations at speed, without leaning on them as a crutch. The editing instinct and the marketing brain come first; the AI tooling supplements them.



What you'll do

Edit and produce short-form video ads for DTC ecommerce (feed, stories, reels) built to perform, not just to look nice.

Structure hooks that work in the first few seconds, visually and through audio, and pace the whole cut to hold attention to the CTA.



Adapt tone, pacing, and format to each brand and each placement so the ad feels native and on-brand.

Bring a conversion mindset to every cut: you understand the funnel the ad sits in and what it needs to do.

Use AI video and image tools to generate B-roll, fill gaps, and spin up variations quickly, as a supplement to your editing, not a replacement for it.

Clean and shape audio so it sounds natural: voiceover, music, pacing, sync, and sound design.

Add motion graphics, text animation, captions, transitions, and effects that lift retention and clarity.

Produce supporting static creative and variations when a campaign needs them.

Work to brief, manage multiple brands at once, and keep tasks moving in our project-management tools.



Qualifications

Must-have

A marketer's understanding of what makes ads convert: consumer psychology, direct response, hooks, retention, and CTA, not just production skill.

~2+ years editing short-form video for paid social or ecommerce (agency, in-house, or freelance).

A portfolio of DTC / ecommerce video ads. We want to see performance work, ideally ads that ran as paid Meta creative, not only brand reels or logo work.

Strong, fast video editing (Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci, CapCut, or similar).

A real point of view on hook structure, visual and audio, and on how format changes by platform and placement.

Detail-oriented, organized, responsive, and able to manage multiple brands at pace.

Available during U.S. working hours (EST/CST overlap preferred).

Nice-to-have (strong pluses)

Hands-on with AI video and image generation (Runway, Sora, Kling, Veo, Pika, etc.) for B-roll, variations, and speed, with a sense of which tool fits which job.

Natural-sounding AI audio: voice generation/cloning and sound design that doesn't sound synthetic (ElevenLabs or similar).

Motion-graphics depth, plus strong layout, typography, and visual hierarchy.

Graphic design in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator).

Landing-page / web design, and familiarity with Shopify, WordPress, or similar.

Exposure to AI ad-production platforms (e.g. SuperScale) and creative-analytics tools.



Why this role

Own performance video creative for a range of ecommerce brands.

Fast-paced, hands-on, with real ownership of the output and the results it drives.

Use AI to move faster than traditional editors, without losing the marketing craft that makes ads actually convert.

title: Short Form Video Editor - TikTok Shop
description:
Short Form Video Editor  - TikTok Shop



I am seeking a talented video editor with an eye for detail for recreating existing TikTok shop videos. The ideal candidate understands the importance of visual, verbal, and on screen text hooks, content that grabs attention and stops the scroll, keeping the viewer watching through quick cuts, zoom ins, and a strong call to action at the end of the video. You should also understand the value of subtly focusing on “engagement bait” and not editing out things that are intentionally out of place or odd that will get people engaging (commenting) on the post. 



In the beginning this will likely be roughly 10 hours a week but for the right candidate this could be a long term relationship, with the opportunity for many many more additional hours. (See below)



How it would work:



I will provide you with long 3-5 min unedited clips, and voice over files. I will then send you links of 3-5 example TikTok posts that have proven to go viral or earn sales. Your job will to be to take the provided clips and audio to recreate the videos that were sent by link. So you must have an eye for detail, the videos should be as close to the original as possible. 



Once I can see that you have grasped the editing style that is effective and we both understand what each other is looking for, that is when hours can increase to however much you would like to work. What that would look like is, me asking you to use your creative freedom to take previous created videos that have been proven successful and basically putting the clips in a different order to repurpose old content that is very similar without it being an identical recreation. 



Here are examples so you can see an example of the type video styles similar to the ones I will be asking for you to recreate:









You should have experience with 



- Short-form vertical videos (7 seconds to 45 seconds) with tight cuts, removing filler/dead air, quick pacing that holds retention

- Photo overlays

- Captions/subtitles

- On screen text



You're a strong fit if you:



1. Have a reel/portfolio of short form edits I can watch (not long form videos)

2. Have and understanding for super quick pacing and retention (you know how to stop the scroll) 

4. Can match an existing video rather than trying to create your own (I'll give you examples to recreate) including screenshotting and using photo overlays that are in the existing video.

5. Are reliable with deadlines and communicate proactively about timelines

6. Turn around revisions quickly and take feedback well

7. If you feel comfortable asking for something when is not there (for example if the inspiration video has a a section where the video or audio was not created, I want to be informed)



Tools



- Confident in Capcut or other video editor (vertical landscape edits for TikTok)

- Comfortable receiving large raw files via DropBox or Google Drive



Requirements

1. Editing computer that can handle 1080p/4K footage

2. Reliable internet with solid upload speed (you'll need to be able to move large files)

3. About 10 hrs/week availability, ongoing, with the ability for that to drastically increase

4. A reel or portfolio link with short-form work (required) 

5. Experience with short form content (it does not have to be TikTok shop content) if your only experience is long form content unfortunately you are not the candidate I am looking for. 



How to apply (read carefully)



Link your reel/portfolio, ideally with at least one short edit I can watch start to finish.



Pick ONE short-form edit in your portfolio and tell me, in 2–3 sentences, how you would change it based on what I am looking for.



List the editing software you use.



Tell me your typical turn around for 3-5 short videos (15 secs to 45 secs each) similar to the ones above.



What is your internet upload speed?



Start your message with the word [RETENTION] so I know you read this fully. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



I watch every reel from applicants who follow all of these steps. Please note your experience and resume is less important than your ability to quickly understand what I am looking for and your attention to small details to recreate a post. Excited to see your work!

title: Social Media & Content Specialist
description:
About True Cloud AI

True Cloud AI is a local managed services provider (MSP) that helps law firms with 5–25 attorneys reduce IT risk, protect client confidentiality, and run more productive practices. We provide IT support, cybersecurity, cloud services, and compliance-focused technology guidance.



We are not a national agency or a noisy social brand. We are a local, relationship-driven business that wants to become the most trusted technology resource for small law firms in our region.



Role Summary

The Social Media & Content Specialist will own True Cloud AI’s daily social media presence and content marketing efforts.



This role is not about selling on social media. Your job is to build a credible local brand, earn attention from law firm decision-makers and their referral networks, and drive organic traffic to the True Cloud AI website through helpful, educational content.



You will translate technical IT and cybersecurity topics into clear, practical content that helps law firm owners, office managers, and attorneys understand risk, productivity, and compliance — without jargon or scare tactics.



The ideal candidate understands that a 5–25 attorney law firm is not scrolling social media looking for IT support. They know how to create content that appears when those firms search, gets shared by local professional networks, and positions True Cloud AI as a helpful local expert before a sales conversation ever happens.



Principal Responsibilities

Content Planning and Execution

Build and maintain a content calendar across LinkedIn,
, Instagram, YouTube, and Google Business Profile.



Write educational, plain-language copy for daily posts, short-form video scripts, infographics, and website/blog articles.



Repurpose social content into website articles, local SEO pages,
 newsletter content, and downloadable resources designed to generate organic traffic.



Schedule and publish posts optimized for each platform, while keeping the website and local search presence in mind.



Maintain a consistent brand voice: clear, practical, trustworthy, and respectful of the legal profession.



Translate complex IT topics — cybersecurity, data backup, compliance, cloud migration, Microsoft 365, cyber insurance — into accessible content for non-technical law firm leaders.



Community Presence

Monitor and engage with comments, replies, DMs, and local community discussions daily.



Thoughtfully interact with local bar associations, chambers of commerce, legal technology vendors, insurance brokers, and other professional referral partners to build local visibility.



Maintain a professional online presence that reflects the trust and discretion expected by law firms.



Strategy and Innovation

Research and report on audience preferences, platform changes, and local SEO content opportunities.



Pitch new content ideas and formats to leadership.



Use analytics to measure what drives website traffic, engagement, and content downloads — not vanity metrics.



Identify opportunities to improve local brand visibility, including Google Business Profile updates, local search terms, and referral partner content.



Quality and Process

Follow established approval workflow to ensure brand alignment and technical accuracy before publishing.



Exercise strong attention to detail around grammar, punctuation, brand consistency, links, tags, and assets.



Flag potential issues proactively, especially around cybersecurity claims, compliance language, or client confidentiality.



Support day-to-day marketing operations such as project intake, Asana tracking, and content coordination.



Video Content (Desired, but Not Required)

Edit short-form video content for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn.



Identify relatable, professional formats and adapt them for a local B2B audience.



Minimum Qualifications

3–5 years of professional social media and/or content marketing experience.



Proven track record of creating content that drives measurable website traffic, engagement, or lead generation.



Experience writing for professional audiences; B2B, legal, healthcare, financial, or IT services experience strongly preferred.



Ability to translate technical or regulated subject matter into clear, compliant, non-salesy content.



Strong understanding of content marketing and local SEO basics.



Growth mindset with experience setting KPIs and using analytics to improve performance.



Excellent editing skills: grammar, punctuation, tone, and attention to detail.



Must be able to work Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. US Eastern Time.



Preferred Qualifications

WordPress, SEO, Google Analytics, LinkedIn,
, Instagram, YouTube



Short-form video editing experience



Experience in a managed services provider, legal services, or professional services environment



Familiarity with legal technology, cybersecurity, compliance, or IT support topics



Experience with Google Business Profile and local search



Application Note

Please submit a cover letter, resume, and portfolio showcasing relevant writing samples, particularly any work in B2B, professional services, legal, IT, or cybersecurity. Include metrics or outcomes where possible to demonstrate how your content increased website traffic, engagement, or leads.

. Collaborative team — we talk often, swap ideas, and want you involved.

title: Travel Community Manager (Part-Time, Long-Term)
description:
**JOB TYPE:** Part-time, 20 hrs/week

**SALARY:** $450–650 USD/month, depending on experience

**COMPANY:** Vohana DMC





**ABOUT US**



Vohana DMC is a destination management company in Hawai'i. We handle the ground side of travel across O'ahu, Maui, Kaua'i, and the Big Island — operator relationships, bookings, on-island logistics — for travel advisors whose clients are heading to the islands. The advisor designs the trip. We make it actually happen once their client lands.



We're growing our presence in the US travel advisor community, where thousands of independent advisors sell Hawai'i without a dedicated partner on the ground here. We want to be the Hawai'i partner they think of first.



**THE ROLE**



You'll be our voice in the travel advisor community. You'll spend your time in forums and groups where advisors ask questions, share problems, and look for help — and you'll be the person who shows up, joins the conversation, and is genuinely useful.



Here's the important part: **you don't need to already know Hawai'i.** We live here. When an advisor asks something you can't answer, you bring it to us, we give you the real answer, and you take it back to the conversation. Over time you'll build serious Hawai'i knowledge — but it comes from us, not from you inventing it.



What we're hiring for is the personality and the consistency. Someone who's curious, likable in writing, asks good questions, and shows up every week.



**WHAT YOU'LL DO**



- Be active daily in travel advisor forums and groups — reading, replying, joining conversations

- Answer Hawai'i questions using knowledge we give you; ask us when you don't know

- Study the islands consistently: hotels, activities, seasons, what makes each island different

- Notice which advisors are working on Hawai'i trips and start real relationships with them

- Flag good opportunities to us so we can follow up

- Keep simple notes on who you're talking to and what they need

- Make occasional light visuals in Canva

- Learn our DESK booking platform (we'll train you)



**WHO THIS IS FOR**



Someone a little obsessed with travel. You read hotel reviews for fun and you'd happily fall down a research rabbit hole about Kaua'i's north shore. You're warm and natural in writing — people reply to you. You're not afraid to say "let me find out" instead of bluffing.



**WHO THIS IS NOT FOR**



This is a remote role based in the Philippines. There is no travel involved. If you're applying hoping for trips to Hawai'i, this isn't it. We need someone who loves the *industry* — the hotels, the itineraries, the craft of putting a trip together.



Also not for you if you go quiet. This role only works if you show up consistently and stay in touch with us.



**REQUIREMENTS**



- Excellent, natural written English — you sound like a person, not a brochure

- Genuinely interested in travel and hospitality

- Self-directed. Most of your work happens while Hawai'i is asleep

- Comfortable asking questions rather than guessing

- Google Workspace, Canva, and comfortable with AI tools for research

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace



**NICE TO HAVE**



- Travel, hospitality, or tourism background

- Community management, forum moderation, or social media experience

- Experience with a CRM



**SCHEDULE & PAY**



- 20 hrs/week, mostly async on your own schedule

- A few fixed check-in hours weekly overlapping Hawai'i time

- $450–650 USD/month

- Performance bonus available once you're up and running

- Long-term role with room to grow to full-time as the channel scales



**HOW TO APPLY**



Start your application with the word **HONU** so I know you read this.



Then answer briefly:



1. What travel brand, blog, or creator do you follow closely, and what do they do well?

2. Tell us about an online community you've been genuinely active in — any kind, doesn't have to be work. What did you post about?

3. What's your available start date and weekly schedule?



Applications without the codeword or without answers to all three questions won't be reviewed.

title: Operations Coordinator
description:
We are a fast-growing U.S.-based IT solutions company seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Operations Coordinator to join our team. This role supports the Operations team by keeping assigned field-service projects and work orders moving from planning through completion. The position coordinates technicians, clients, vendors, travel, materials, schedules, and project information; identifies risks early; and takes practical action to resolve issues within established guidelines.

This is a high-autonomy individual-contributor role with enhanced operational ownership. Success requires more than receiving and completing assigned tasks. The coordinator investigates, proposes solutions, communicates directly—often by phone—and follows each assigned issue through to a documented resolution.



Key responsibilities

Project and field operations coordination

· Coordinate multiple field-service projects and work orders from preparation through completion, maintaining visibility of scope, deadlines, dependencies, owners, and next actions.

· Arrange or support procurement and delivery of required materials, verify status, and address delays before they affect the client or field team.

· Monitor project progress and deliverables, challenge unclear or incomplete information, and follow up until commitments are closed.

Problem-solving and decision-making

· Investigate issues by gathering facts, identifying the root cause, evaluating options, and recommending or implementing the best practical solution.

· Make timely decisions within approved playbooks and authority limits, considering client impact, safety, cost, schedule, service quality, and operational risk.

Client, vendor, and technician communication

· Serve as a primary operational contact for clients, vendors, and field technicians through phone,
, and collaboration platforms.

· Initiate calls when a live conversation will resolve an issue faster, reduce misunderstanding, or protect the client experience.

· Manage difficult or time-sensitive conversations calmly; clarify expectations, agree next steps, confirm ownership, and document outcomes.

· Provide proactive status updates and communicate risks or changes before stakeholders need to ask.

Operational discipline and improvement

· Maintain complete and accurate project records, service confirmations, purchase details, communications, and follow-up items in company systems.

· Use trackers, calendars, task-management tools, and escalation routines to manage competing priorities without relying on memory.

· Identify recurring friction, document evidence, and propose practical improvements; support approved changes to workflows, templates, checklists, and operating procedures.



What success looks like

· Field activities are planned accurately and confirmed before technicians travel or arrive on site.

· Operational problems are identified early, assessed logically, and driven to resolution with minimal avoidable escalation.

· Schedules, commitments, materials, travel details, project records, and outstanding actions remain current and reliable.

· Recurring issues are documented and raised with practical improvement suggestions.



Required qualifications

· At least three years of experience in project coordination, operations coordination, service delivery, field operations, logistics, implementation, or a comparable role involving multiple stakeholders and deadlines.

· Demonstrated experience independently resolving operational or project problems—not only receiving and completing assigned tasks.

· Strong spoken and written English, with the confidence and professionalism to conduct frequent phone conversations with clients, vendors, and field technicians.

· Ability to manage several active projects, changing priorities, detailed records, and time-sensitive commitments with limited supervision.

· Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to adapt quickly and learn new systems.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Office and modern collaboration, project-tracking, or task-management tools.

· Reliable high-speed internet, a backup connectivity/power plan, and a dedicated, distraction-free home office.

· Ability and willingness to work a consistent U.S. Eastern Time schedule, including the corresponding overnight hours in the Philippines and U.S. daylight-saving time changes.



Preferred qualifications

· Experience in IT services, telecommunications, construction, logistics, field services, technical support operations, or another environment coordinating distributed resources.

· Experience coordinating technician dispatch, travel, procurement, materials, vendors

· Working knowledge of Agile or Scrum methodologies, with experience using iterative planning, visual workflow management, regular prioritization, retrospectives, or similar practices to coordinate work and improve delivery.

· Experience using Odoo ERP or a comparable ERP/service-management platform.

· Experience improving a workflow, building a tracker or standard operating procedure, or introducing a process that reduced delays or errors.





What We Offer

· Weekly pay of $300, always on time.

· Fixed weekends off.

· 7 U.S. Federal Holidays.

· 15 days of paid leave (10 PTO + 5 Sick Days).

· 13th Month Pay.

· Annual Performance Review.

· Long-term career opportunities with a clear growth path.

· Permanent work-from-home position.

· Supportive, collaborative, and growth-focused team culture.





How to Apply



If you're excited to join our growing IT solutions company, we'd love to hear from you.



Please submit your application with the subject line "Operations Coordinator" and begin the first line of your cover letter with the phrase:



Blue Mockingbird



This step is important as it helps us identify candidates who carefully read and follow instructions. Applications that do not include this requirement will not be considered.



Your application must include:

- Full Name

- Updated Resume/CV

- WhatsApp Number

- Verifiable references from previous employers

- A video introduction explaining why you are the best fit for this role (required)



Applications that are incomplete, including those submitted without the required video introduction, will not be considered.



We look forward to meeting a motivated professional who is ready to grow with us and contribute to a fast-paced, collaborative team. If you're looking for a long-term opportunity where your work has a meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply.

title: Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller (List Builder)
description:
Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller

Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience Required: 1–2 Years



Turn Your Voice Into Your Biggest Asset



Are you the person who can get a "no" and still walk away with a callback? Do you thrive on the thrill of a great pitch and love closing the gap between a cold lead and a booked appointment? We're looking for a Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller who's ready to bring energy, persistence, and persuasion to a growing, fast-paced commercial real estate team.

This isn't just dialing numbers — it's the front line of our acquisitions pipeline for commercial properties, including office, retail, industrial, multifamily (5+ units), and mixed-use assets. Every call you make has the potential to turn into a deal, and every deal you help set up is a direct reflection of your skill on the phone. Commercial deals move differently than residential — longer relationships, bigger stakes, and owners or decision-makers who expect a caller who sounds like they know the space.

If you're confident, quick on your feet, and genuinely enjoy the game of turning "not interested" into "let's talk," we want to hear from you.



What You'll Do



Make outbound cold calls to commercial property owners, landlords, investors, asset managers, and brokers across asset classes (office, retail, industrial, multifamily, mixed-use)

Pull and build targeted call lists using county records, CRE data platforms, and public/private property databases

Identify and qualify off-market and undervalued commercial properties based on owner motivation, property condition, and financial indicators

Gather key property details: lease type (NNN, gross, modified gross), tenant occupancy/vacancy status, square footage, zoning, and ownership structure

Research and reach decision-makers directly — including owners, property managers, LLC representatives, and asset managers — not just front-desk contacts

Set qualified appointments for our acquisitions/sales team with clear notes on deal potential

Maintain and update CRM with detailed call notes, property data, and lead status

Follow call scripts while keeping conversations natural, credible, and tailored to commercial owners

Hit daily/weekly call volume, talk-time, and lead generation targets

Handle objections with confidence — especially from sophisticated owners, brokers, and gatekeepers who are used to fielding investor calls



What You Bring



1–2 years of experience in a call center handling international accounts, and/or real estate cold calling — commercial experience strongly preferred

Excellent English communication skills (neutral accent preferred)

Comfort speaking with business owners, investors, and brokers — not just residential homeowners

Strong persuasion and negotiation instincts — you know how to read a conversation and steer it

Ability to work independently and stay motivated with minimal supervision

Comfort with high-volume outbound calling and skip tracing/contact research

Experience pulling and building your own lead lists (county records, CRE data platforms, or similar tools)

A target-driven mindset and genuine competitive streak

Familiarity with CRM systems (a plus, not a must)



Bonus Points For



Working knowledge of commercial real estate terminology: cap rate, NOI, NNN/gross leases, cash-on-cash return, CRE asset classes

Experience cold calling for office, retail, industrial, or multifamily acquisitions specifically

Experience with lead generation tools, skip tracing platforms, and auto-dialers

Familiarity with list-pulling/data platforms such as Prop Stream, Reonomy, CoStar, or county assessor records

Prior appointment-setting experience for acquisitions or investment sales teams

Sharp listening skills and objection-handling instincts with sophisticated, high-value prospects



Why You'll Want This Role



Competitive base salary — get rewarded for showing up and doing the work

Performance-based incentives/bonuses — the better you perform, the more you earn

Real growth opportunities — this is a growing company, and top performers won't go unnoticed

A supportive, performance-driven team — we win together, and we celebrate wins



Ready to Make Your Calls Count?



Send your updated resume and a short recording (Loom or Vocaroo — link only)

title: Talented Short-form Video Editor
