## About the Role



We’re looking for four creative, internet-native video editors who know how to turn a script and voiceover into a story people cannot stop watching.



You’ll create polished **3–5-minute, 9:16 videos for Snapchat**, taking ownership of the edit from beginning to end. That means finding the strongest visual assets online, building the story, creating an immediate hook and using pacing, captions, graphics, music and sound design to maintain attention.



This is the role for a talented visual storyteller looking for their next big challenge.



With the support of our Managing Director, you’ll choose a content niche—such as celebrities, sports, hip-hop, crime or influencers—and become our in-house expert on what performs within that space.





## What You’ll Be Doing



* **Create daily Snapchat stories**



  * Edit and deliver one high-quality **3–5-minute vertical video each working day**.

  * Turn a finished script and AI voiceover into a clear, fast-moving visual story.

  * Source strong online assets and combine them with captions, graphics, music, motion and sound design.



* **Own a specialist content niche**



  * Choose and align on a niche with the Managing Director.

  * Learn the important personalities, stories, audiences and formats within that niche.

  * Develop a strong instinct for the hooks, visuals and editing styles that perform best.



* **Keep improving the content**



  * Test new formats, pacing styles, visual treatments and storytelling techniques.

  * Use feedback and performance insights to improve each new video.

  * Help make our editing workflow faster, smarter and more consistent.



* **Work closely with the team**



  * Attend the daily team stand-up call.

  * Remain available and responsive across most of the UK workday.

  * Complete revisions quickly and consistently meet daily deadlines.





## What We’re Looking For



* **Previous short-form video editing experience is required.**

* Strong hands-on experience with both **Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects**.

* A portfolio demonstrating vertical editing, strong pacing and clear visual storytelling.

* A strong understanding of hooks, viewer retention, captions and sound design.

* Good judgement when researching and selecting online visual assets.

* Strong English comprehension, attention to detail and remote communication skills.

* The ability to learn quickly, respond positively to feedback and take ownership of your work.





## What Matters to Us



We don’t care where you went to school, how many years of experience appear on your CV or what you look like.



We care about:



* What you can create.

* How quickly you can learn.

* How well you respond to feedback.

* Whether you can consistently deliver.

* What unique experience, taste and perspective you bring to the team.



You need genuine short-form editing experience, but we care far more about the quality of your work than whether you have been editing for one year or ten.





## How to Apply



 
 with the subject:



**Video Editor Application — [Your Name]**



Include only these four things:



1. Your CV.

2. Links to your strongest videos.

3. A short explanation of why you are the right fit.

4. Your earliest possible start date.



We review and respond to applications daily. Keep an eye on your inbox and spam folder to find out whether you have been selected for the next stage. We will let you know either way.





## Hiring Process



1. Application and portfolio review.

2. A **$20 paid editing task** for selected candidates.

3. Interview.

4. Final job offer.



For the paid task, you’ll receive a shared script and AI voiceover. You’ll need to source the visual assets online and turn them into an engaging **30-second, 9:16 video** that demonstrates your pacing, storytelling and creative style.



Only candidates specifically invited to the paid-task stage should complete the task.

 with the subject:

YOUR DAY



Calling — about 70% of your time



100 outbound calls per day from a list we provide

You will be calling US healthcare professionals: discharge planners, case managers, social workers, facility staff, and home care prospects

Log the outcome of every call in our tracker

Book callbacks and pass warm leads to our US team



 — about 30% of your time



Send follow-up
s to people you have spoken with

Build and schedule campaigns in Constant Contact: upload lists, set up sends, monitor opens and clicks

Write clear subject lines and short follow-up sequences

Send a weekly report: calls made, people reached,
s sent, open rates, leads generated



FIRST WEEK



Your first week is training. We walk you through our scripts, our call lists, our tracker, and our Constant Contact setup, and you start calling with support before you go solo.



WHAT YOU MUST HAVE



Excellent spoken English. You will be on the phone with American healthcare professionals for hours every day. Clear, confident, easy to understand. This is the most important requirement.

Cold calling experience, ideally 50+ calls per day

Experience with Constant Contact

Ability to write professional English
s without relying on templates

Stable internet (please state your speed), a noise-cancelling headset, and a quiet room at night

Willingness to work the night shift consistently, long term



NICE TO HAVE, NOT REQUIRED



Experience calling into US healthcare: hospitals, nursing facilities, home health, group homes

Familiarity with HIPAA-appropriate phone and
 etiquette

Go High Level experience



WHAT WE OFFER



$1,040 USD per month, paid every two weeks on Friday via Remitly

Performance bonuses: $100 for every qualified home care lead, $100 for every group home bed filled

One week of PAID  training before you go solo

The same fixed schedule every week, no rotating shifts

You report directly to the owner. Small team, quick decisions.

A long-term seat. We are hiring someone we intend to keep for years.



BEING HONEST WITH YOU



100 calls a day is a real target and most of those calls will be short. Some people will be rude. You need patience and consistency more than you need to be a brilliant salesperson. In return you get a clear script, a loaded call list, real training, and a manager who will not leave you guessing.



HOW TO APPLY

Your resume

A 60-second voice recording (Vocaroo link is fine) with your name, your cold calling background, and the most calls you have made in one day

One sentence on why night shift works for you



Start your application with the word HOUSTON so we know you read this posting fully. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



We reply to every serious applicant. Shortlisted candidates get a short interview and a paid trial day.

title: Spanish Phone Support
description:
Remote Bilingual Legal Intake Coordinator (English/Spanish) — Full Time, Long-Term



### About the Role

We are a busy U.S. law firm and we are building a 24/7 client-intake desk. When someone calls

our firm, they are often in a stressful legal situation and they need a calm, professional human

to answer — not a voi
. Your job is to be that human. You will answer calls live, return

missed calls fast, monitor messages and online forms, and make sure no potential client ever

falls through the cracks.



This is a long-term, full-time role with a stable schedule. We pay on time, every time, and we

invest in people who take ownership.



### What You'll Do Every Shift

- Answer incoming calls live through our internet phone system (GoTo softphone)

- Return every missed call with a callback attempt **within 2–5 minutes** — this is the most

important measure of success in this role

- Monitor and respond to voi
s and text messages

- Monitor and respond to online intake form submissions (through Clio)

- Take clear intake information: caller name, phone,
, location, type of legal matter,

urgency, and how they found us

- Enter and update every contact in our intake system so nothing is lost

- Schedule consultations on the firm calendar

- Recognize urgent matters (jail/arrest, court deadline, immigration detention, safety issue)

and escalate them immediately using our written escalation list

- Complete a written shift handoff at the end of every shift



> **Important:** You are NOT giving legal advice. You gather information and connect people to the

> right person on our legal team. We train you on exactly what to say.



### Must-Have Requirements

- **Fully fluent in BOTH English and Spanish** — speaking, listening, reading, and writing.

You will switch between languages on live calls. This is non-negotiable.

- Clear, warm, professional phone voice with a neutral accent in both languages

- Reliable high-speed internet **plus a backup internet source** (mobile hotspot or second

provider) — you cannot go offline mid-shift

- A quiet, dedicated work space with no background noise

- A working computer and a noise-cancelling headset

- Strong attention to detail and great note-taking

- Comfortable using web-based software (we train you on GoTo and Clio)

- Dependable and punctual — shifts start on time, every time

- Able to work the **same fixed schedule long-term** (see Schedule below)



### Nice to Have (Not Required)

- Prior experience in customer service, call center, reception, or virtual assistant work

- Prior experience with a law firm, medical office, or other professional services

- Experience with GoTo, RingCentral, or similar VoIP/softphone systems

- Experience with Clio, Clio Grow, or any CRM/intake software



### Schedule

This role covers 7am to 2:30pm Mountain Time, Monday through Friday (Mountain Time)

You must be able to commit to this schedule consistently. 



### Compensation

- Paid monthly, on time

- Long-term role with raises based on performance

- We are looking for someone to grow with us for years, not weeks





To apply, please do ALL of the following. Applications that skip any step will not be reviewed:



1. Watch this video: 
/shorts/oF4x3PdmJaY?is=EiMrMsBwwwrKiIqf

2. Follow the instructions in the video



We review every complete application personally. Thank you — we're excited to meet you.

title: Executive Virtual Assistant
description:
$5–$7 USD/hour | Long-Term Position | Growth Opportunity



We are looking for a smart, dependable, highly organized Virtual Assistant who wants to become a long-term part of our team.



We are not looking for someone who simply completes assigned tasks and waits for the next instruction. We want someone who takes ownership, follows through, thinks ahead, brings ideas, and helps us improve the way we operate.



You do not need to know everything when you start. We will train the right person. What matters most is that you are intelligent, resourceful, dependable, comfortable with technology, and able to learn independently.



Prior appraisal experience is NOT required. We can teach you the appraisal-related portion of the position.



Responsibilities



You will assist with:



Typing and preparing appraisal-related reports and documents

Answering incoming business calls

Communicating professionally with homeowners, lenders, attorneys, real estate professionals, and other clients

Scheduling appraisal appointments

Responding to appraisal bid requests

Negotiating fees and turn times within company guidelines

Managing
s, calendars, orders, files, and client follow-ups

Keeping track of outstanding items and following up without needing to be reminded

Helping organize and improve company systems and workflows

Using ChatGPT and other technology to improve productivity

Assisting with website, marketing, advertising, and business improvement projects as needed



Again, appraisal experience is not required. We are willing to train someone who demonstrates strong learning ability, attention to detail, initiative, professionalism, and reliability.



Schedule & Availability



This position requires consistent availability during U.S. Central Time (CT) business hours.



Work schedules will generally fall within one of the following shifts:



8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CT

9:00 AM – 6:00 PM CT

10:00 AM – 7:00 PM CT



The specific schedule will be determined based on company needs and discussed during the hiring process.



Because this position includes answering business calls, communicating with clients, scheduling appointments, and handling time-sensitive matters, applicants must be able to reliably and consistently work their assigned Central Time schedule.



Computer & Workstation Requirements



Because this position involves working with multiple programs, documents, websites,
s, appraisal software, and other systems at the same time, you must already have an appropriate workstation.



You must have:



A reliable computer capable of handling your daily workload

At least two computer monitors/screens that can be used together as one workstation

Reliable high-speed internet

A working microphone and audio setup for calls and meetings

A dependable backup plan for internet or power outages



A desktop computer plus a completely separate laptop that cannot function as a second connected display does NOT meet the two-screen requirement.



You must be able to work across at least two screens simultaneously from the same workstation.



Please do not apply if you do not currently meet this requirement.



We Want Someone Who Contributes



We do not want someone who does something a certain way simply because “that’s how it has always been done.”



If you notice a better, faster, more organized, or more efficient way to do something, we want you to tell us.



We want someone who:



Takes ownership of assignments from beginning to completion

Follows up without being asked

Notices when something still needs attention

Thinks ahead

Identifies problems and suggests solutions

Brings new ideas to the company

Researches better ways of doing things

Is comfortable respectfully recommending changes

Wants to help the company grow, not simply complete tasks



If you are given responsibility for something, we should not have to continuously remind you that it still needs to be completed.



We want someone who develops their own system for keeping track of responsibilities, deadlines, follow-ups, and outstanding items.



AI & Technology



You do not need to be an AI expert.



However, you must be comfortable learning new technology and figuring things out independently.



We may ask you to research ChatGPT, AI tools, automation, websites, marketing systems, software, or other technology that could help our business.



We want someone who can research it, learn it, test it, help implement it, and then come back and clearly teach us how to use it.



If you encounter something you do not know how to do, your first response should not always be, “I don't know how.”



We value people who are willing to research, troubleshoot, learn, and attempt to find a solution.



If you are carefully reading this job posting, use the exact subject line “Michael Jackson Is Dancing” when submitting your application.



You Should Be

Highly organized and detail-oriented

Reliable and consistent

Strong in written and spoken English

Comfortable speaking with U.S.-based clients by phone

Professional and confident

Able to work independently

A strong problem solver

Comfortable learning new technology

Able to follow instructions carefully

Proactive and willing to take initiative

Comfortable receiving feedback

Interested in a long-term position and growing with one company

Able to consistently work during your assigned U.S. Central Time schedule

Able to manage multiple responsibilities and follow-ups without constant supervision



Experience with customer service, executive assistance, real estate, mortgage, scheduling, ChatGPT, websites, marketing, CRM systems, or automation is a plus.



Appraisal experience is a plus but is NOT required.



Pay & Growth



Starting pay is $5–$7 USD/hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.



We plan to conduct a performance review after approximately 90 days. Strong performance, increased independence, and greater responsibility can lead to increased compensation and advancement.



We are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of the company over the long term.



How to Apply



Please answer each of the following questions:



Briefly introduce yourself and describe your work experience.

Describe your experience answering phones and communicating with clients.

Tell us about your experience with ChatGPT or other AI tools. Limited experience is okay.

Give one example of something you did not know how to do but successfully researched and learned on your own.

Tell us about a time you noticed something at work that could be done better. What did you recommend or change?

If you were assigned something that required follow-up several days later, how would you make sure it was completed without your manager reminding you?

Tell us about any experience with scheduling, negotiating, real estate, websites, marketing, or automation.

List the software and online tools you are comfortable using.

Describe your primary computer and workstation setup.

Confirm that you currently have at least two monitors/screens that can be used simultaneously as part of the same workstation.

Describe your internet connection and your backup plan for internet or power outages.

Which of the following Central Time schedules can you consistently work: 8 AM–5 PM, 9 AM–6 PM, or 10 AM–7 PM? Please list all that apply.

What hourly rate are you requesting between $5 and $7 USD/hour, and why?

Why are you interested in a long-term position?

Voice Recording Required



Along with your written application, please send a short voice recording introducing yourself and briefly discussing your work experience.



This position requires regular communication with U.S.-based clients by phone, so the voice recording will help us evaluate spoken English, communication style, professionalism, clarity, and comfort speaking.



Applications submitted without the requested voice recording may not receive further consideration.



Interview Process & Typing Test



Candidates whose applications appear to be a strong match may be invited to move forward to the interview stage.

title: Durable Medical Equipment (DME) Billing Specialist
description:
Position: Durable Medical Equipment (DME) Billing Specialist



Starting Salary: PHP 45,000 per month, with opportunities for future growth and salary increases based on performance and increased responsibilities



Schedule: Full-Time | Remote | U.S. Business Hours



We are hiring an experienced Durable Medical Equipment (DME) Billing Specialist to support a growing U.S.-based healthcare organization.



Durable Medical Equipment includes medical equipment and supplies intended for ongoing patient use, such as wheelchairs, walkers, hospital beds, oxygen equipment, CPAP machines, and similar items.



The role will focus on DME insurance verification, documentation review, claim submission, denial resolution, payment posting, and accounts receivable follow-up.



Direct experience using TrueSight by Medbill is a major advantage and will receive priority consideration.



This is a long-term opportunity for an experienced DME billing professional who communicates clearly, takes ownership, solves problems, and follows every claim through payment or final resolution.



NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS



• Minimum 2 years of hands-on DME or HME billing experience



• Experience billing Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance carriers



• Strong understanding of the complete DME billing and revenue-cycle process



• Knowledge of HCPCS codes, ICD-10 codes, modifiers, payer requirements, medical necessity, and DME documentation



• Experience with eligibility verification, prior authorizations, claim submission, denials, appeals, payment posting, and AR follow-up



• Ability to review prescriptions, physician orders, supporting documentation, and proof of delivery



• Strong outbound calling skills and confidence speaking with U.S.-based insurance representatives



• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills



• Strong organization, accuracy, documentation, and follow-through



• Ability to work independently and take ownership of claims until payment or final resolution



HIGHLY PREFERRED



• Direct experience using TrueSight by Medbill



Candidates with hands-on TrueSight experience should clearly identify this in their application and describe how they used the platform.



IMPORTANT



This is not a general medical billing, bookkeeping, accounts payable, virtual assistant, or basic data-entry position.



Applicants must have direct experience billing for Durable Medical Equipment. Candidates without relevant DME or HME billing experience may not be considered.



We need someone who understands the specialized documentation, coding, payer requirements, and follow-up involved in DME billing. The right candidate must be comfortable contacting insurance companies, investigating unpaid or denied claims, making corrections, and following up consistently until payment is received.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Verify patient eligibility, insurance benefits, and DME coverage



• Obtain and track prior authorizations when required



• Review prescriptions, physician orders, medical-necessity documentation, and proof of delivery



• Confirm that all billing information and supporting documentation are complete



• Apply the correct HCPCS codes, ICD-10 codes, modifiers, units, and payer information



• Prepare, review, and submit accurate DME claims



• Manage recurring rental, resupply, and other DME-specific billing when applicable



• Monitor rejected, denied, delayed, and underpaid claims



• Correct and resubmit claims and prepare appeals when necessary



• Post and reconcile payments, ERAs, EOBs, adjustments, and patient balances



• Monitor AR aging and follow up on outstanding claims



• Contact insurance companies by phone,
, and payer portals



• Obtain claim status, reference numbers, expected payment dates, required corrections, and clear next steps



• Document all calls, claim updates, responses, and follow-up dates



• Provide clear reports regarding claims, denials, collections, and outstanding AR



• Follow every assigned claim through payment or final resolution



TO APPLY, PLEASE SUBMIT



• Resume



• OnlineJobs Profile Link



• Number of years of direct DME or HME billing experience



• Types of DME products and insurance payers you have worked with



• List of DME billing, clearinghouse, insurance, and payer platforms you have used



• Details regarding any direct experience with TrueSight by Medbill



• Average number of claims or accounts you managed



• Average number of outbound payer follow-up calls you handled daily



• One example of a denied or unpaid DME claim you successfully resolved and the steps you took



• A short voice recording introducing yourself, summarizing your DME billing experience, and demonstrating how you would speak with an insurance representative regarding an unpaid or denied DME claim



Applications missing the requested information or voice recording may not be considered.



WORK SETUP



• Full-time, permanent remote position



• Philippines-based candidates only



• Must be available during U.S. business hours



• Reliable computer, high-speed internet, backup internet or power solution, and professional home-office environment required



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS



• Starting salary of PHP 45,000 per month



• Opportunities for future salary increases based on performance, professional growth, increased responsibilities, and overall contribution



• Work from home



• Paid training



• Stable, long-term position



• Opportunities for advancement



We are looking for a highly capable Durable Medical Equipment Billing Specialist who combines strong technical billing knowledge with excellent communication, persistence, accuracy, and personal accountability.

Assist in sending outbound

s

title: Webinar Host to Start ASAP
description:
We are looking for a confident, engaging, and professional Webinar Host to join our team for a long-term opportunity.



The main responsibilities include hosting and presenting during live webinars, as well as recording video content needed for the webinar and marketing campaigns.



Responsibilities:



* Host and present during live webinars in a confident, engaging, and professional manner.

* Clearly explain webinar topics, offers, and key information to attendees.

* Record videos needed for the webinar and promotional content.

* Follow provided scripts, talking points, and guidelines when applicable.

* Maintain a professional and energetic presence throughout the webinar.

* Work closely with the team to improve webinar performance and audience engagement.



Requirements:



* Must be fluent in English with impeccable spoken and written English.

* Excellent communication and presentation skills.

* Confident and comfortable speaking on camera.

* Strong ability to engage and connect with an online audience.

* Professional, energetic, and articulate on camera.

* Able to record high-quality videos.

* Reliable and available for scheduled webinars and video recording.

* Previous webinar hosting, sales presentation, or on-camera experience is a strong advantage.



Compensation:



* 5%–10% of webinar profit, depending on the agreed arrangement and performance.

* $50 per video created.

* Opportunity for increased compensation based on performance and results.



Long-Term Opportunity:



This is intended to be a long-term role for the right candidate. If you consistently deliver high-quality presentations and videos and contribute to strong webinar results, there will be an opportunity for ongoing work and increased responsibilities.



If you have excellent English, are confident on camera, and enjoy presenting to an audience, we’d love to hear from you.
